name: Batang Quiapo
description: A young man rises to be one of the biggest outlaws in the neighborhood while he navigates his way in life to survive in Quiapo. Hoping to earn the affection of his parents, his feat draws him closer to the truth about his identity.

credits_cast.character: Jesus Nazareno V. Dimaguiba / Tanggol / Young Ramon Montenegro
credits_cast.name: Coco Martin

videos.title: The Rise of Quiapo Kid
videos.overview: Wanting to prove his worth as a crime lord's son, Ramon sets out to accomplish a bank robbery right in the middle of bustling Quiapo. When things do not go as planned, however, Ramon makes a decision to save his legacy through violence and assault.

videos.title: Who Is Tanggol?
videos.overview: Oblivious to his true identity, Tanggol grows up constantly trying to earn his parents' affection despite receiving familial love from his grandmother. Years later, he becomes a notorious outlaw in the neighborhood.

videos.title: Life in Quiapo
videos.overview: Ramon ends up spending years in prison but eventually manages to establish his power among the inmates. Tanggol gets involved in a riot after coming to his brother's rescue, leaving a bad impression on the residents yet again.

videos.title: Ramon's Escape
videos.overview: With his promotion on the line, Rigor is forced to make a compromise at work. Tanggol and Mokang, meanwhile, end up spending the whole day together. Ramon's escape plan takes a bloody turn.

videos.title: Threats of Sigwa
videos.overview: The Tondo gang starts to cause trouble in Quiapo. Rigor beats Tanggol to a pulp upon getting wind of his involvement in the recent riot. Ramon sets his priorities straight as Don Julio gives him an important role.

videos.title: Tanggol's Recovery
videos.overview: After getting a beating from Rigor, Tanggol tries to make amends by doing chores in the house. News about Ramon's escape triggers Marites to revisit old wounds. Meanwhile, Don Julio and Olga discuss what needs to be done now that Ramon has returned.

videos.title: The Sons of Quiapo
videos.overview: While Don Julio keeps the police in the dark about his fugitive son's whereabouts, a suspicious Ramon warns Olga against betraying him. An ex-convict returns to Quiapo, outsmarting the unsuspecting Tanggol.

videos.title: Encounter
videos.overview: Rigor's family concerns continue to pile up as he learns of a complaint against Tindeng and Marites. Tanggol finds himself in a life-threatening situation after his group's violent encounter with the Tondo gang.

videos.title: Wounds Then, Wounds Now
videos.overview: With the support of Lucio's gang, Supremo sets his sights on getting back at the people responsible for his imprisonment. Unaware of Tanggol's condition, Rigor warns Marites about Ramon's possible return.

videos.title: The Deepest Wound
videos.overview: Tanggol goes against Abdul's advice and decides to go home instead amid his injury. Ramon comes clean to Don Julio about his missing son, prompting the Montenegro patriarch to confront Olga.

videos.title: Tanggol's Sorrow
videos.overview: Rigor grows suspicious of Tanggol after discovering the latter's gunshot wound. Tanggol, on the other hand, vows to settle the score with the Tondo gang. Don Julio devises a plan to keep Ramon away from the public eye once and for all.

videos.title: Deep Rivalry
videos.overview: Tindeng faces serious trouble following a fight with Roda. While Olga and Greg fret over Don Julio's secret plans, Ramon and Rigor cross paths anew as the latter goes after the notorious criminal to take revenge.

videos.title: Death and Resurrection
videos.overview: Unaware of the Montenegros' deception, Rigor basks in satisfaction believing that he has fulfilled his personal vendetta against Ramon. Despite her frustrations about her social status, Mokang ends up inviting her classmates to her debut.

videos.title: Rigor's Success
videos.overview: Unaware that Tanggol sneaks Tolits and Tala into their house, Marites hopes that Rigor can now accept her son as his own following the news of Ramon's death. Infuriated by Don Julio's cunning move, Olga and Greg hatch a devious plan.

videos.title: Impending Disasters
videos.overview: With the cat out of the bag, Tanggol tries to tug at his family's heartstrings in order to let Tolits and Tala live with them. Supremo's group prepares to recruit new members to strengthen their forces. A new threat looms over Tanggol's gang.

videos.title: Wrong Suspicion
videos.overview: Tanggol finally gets his family's approval to let Tolits and Tala stay with them. Following his latest achievement as a cop, Rigor gets summoned by Colonel Suarez, only to be faced with quite the opposite of what his colleagues are expecting.

videos.title: Dismantled Position
videos.overview: Oblivious to Sarah and her friends' pretense, Mokang ends up accepting their offer to help with her debut. Marites, Tindeng, and Noy rush to confront the only suspect they have in mind after finding their Quiapo stall in shambles.

videos.title: Resurgence
videos.overview: Supremo and his gang scout for new blood from the petty criminals of Quiapo in a bid to reinforce their group. Upset over the unexpected trouble at work, Rigor lashes out at his family over Tolits and Tala's stay.

videos.title: Oppressed by Money
videos.overview: Desperate to impress his friends at school by treating them, David resorts to a dishonest way to get some money. Just when Marites thought that things could not get any worse for her family, Rhoda hits them with his response to Tindeng's assault.

videos.title: Justice is Blind
videos.overview: Sarah's prank on Mokang backfires on her when JP comes to her injured classmate's rescue. Marites' plea falls on deaf ears as Rigor refuses to help Tindeng get out of jail.

videos.title: Bail
videos.overview: The arrival of a potential business partner gives Greg the opportunity to prove his worth to Don Julio. While Marites struggles to raise money for Tindeng's bail, Tanggol promises to get his grandmother out of jail by himself.

videos.title: Steal
videos.overview: Despite the risks, Supremo and his gang proceed with their house heist plan with the help of the new recruits. Tanggol grows suspicious of David after discovering that a significant amount of his money is missing.

videos.title: Sworn
videos.overview: Enraged upon catching David in the act of stealing his money, Tanggol resorts to violence and beats his younger brother to a pulp. However, it does not take long for Rigor to see David's state and goes berserk.

videos.title: House Invasion
videos.overview: Marites starts to regret her decision to kick Tanggol out of the house after hearing the truth behind her sons' fight. Tanggol, on the other hand, resolves to confront the root of his family's misfortune and charges into Roda's house.

videos.title: Debt
videos.overview: Nita and Marcing proceed to borrow money from Roda for Mokang's debut. Supremo takes interest in the Tondo gang after witnessing their encounter with the police. Tanggol resorts to desperate ways in order to gather money for Tindeng's bail.

videos.title: Revenge
videos.overview: Tanggol executes his plan to sneak into Roda's house and exact revenge. Mokang sheds happy tears upon securing the money for her debut thanks to her parents. Greg's potential transaction with the Europeans gets foiled by Don Julio.

videos.title: Lies and Freedom
videos.overview: Olga plans to strike back at Ramon after Don Julio made his son in charge of their transaction with the Europeans. Using the money he stole from Roda, Tanggol manages to get Tindeng out of jail.

videos.title: Free
videos.overview: An unforeseen incident leaves Mokang devastated while shopping in Divisoria. Supremo's group purchases top grade weapons in preparation for their vengeful attack on Augustus. Tanggol wallows in sorrow as he relives painful memories of his family.

videos.title: New Preparations
videos.overview: Ramon makes a move to establish under-the-table connections with some officials as a way to secure the Montenegros' illegal dealings. Tanggol sets his sights on acquiring guns in preparation for his revenge against the Tondo gang.

videos.title: Parent and Ally
videos.overview: Tindeng finds a way to locate Tanggol's whereabouts after learning that Marites drove him out of the house. Armed with weapons, Tanggol and his group set out to settle the score with the Tondo gang.

videos.title: Invitation
videos.overview: Mokang and JP continue to grow closer as the former's debut approaches, much to Sarah's dismay. Rigor gets wind of the burglary at Roda's house. Tanggol and his group's hunt for the Tondo gang gets interrupted by an unusual encounter.

videos.title: Welcome
videos.overview: Edwin manages to borrow some money from the Tondo gang, unaware of Teban's ulterior motive. On the way to the rehearsal venue for her debut, Mokang and her schoolmates encounter Tanggol's group.

videos.title: Bad Plan
videos.overview: Mokang successfully wraps up the dance rehearsal, oblivious to Sarah's wicked ploy for her debut and Tanggol's mischievous plan against her schoolmates. Greg's crucial assignment ends in disaster.

videos.title: Annoyance and Anger
videos.overview: Tanggol's prank on Mokang's schoolmates puts her upcoming debut in jeopardy. Finding it a perfect opportunity for her hidden agenda, Olga tries to convince Greg to work with Ramon.

videos.title: Mokang's Revenge
videos.overview: Marites turns to Tanggol's friends in a bid to find her son and convince him to go back home. Guilt-ridden over the trouble he has caused, Tanggol resolves to apologize to Mokang.

videos.title: Exploitation
videos.overview: Mokang's attempt to patch things up with JP takes an unexpected turn. A heated confrontation ensues between Rigor and Roda at the police station. Tanggol remains determined to find a way to attend Mokang's debut.

videos.title: Aggressive
videos.overview: Ramon begins his plan to penetrate the drug market in Quiapo, while Supremo and his group aggressively continue their heists. Tanggol thinks of the perfect people to help him and his friends prepare for Mokang's debut.

videos.title: New Form
videos.overview: Tanggol is forced to come clean to Tindeng about the means he used to fund her bail. The Tondo boys set out to hunt down Tanggol and Edwin. Later, Tanggol and his friends find their way to Loi's boutique.

videos.title: Beginning of Fun
videos.overview: Mokang's much-awaited night has finally arrived. Tension starts to rise in the Montenegro household over Ramon's new venture. All looking decent in their formal attire, Tanggol and his friends try to sneak in to crash Mokang's party.

videos.title: Dance
videos.overview: Marites' worries pile up as Rigor confronts her about Roda's accusations against their family. JP starts making advances at Mokang which leaves the debutante uncomfortable, prompting Tanggol to take matters into his own hands.

videos.title: Thorn or Rose
videos.overview: With JP out of the picture, Tanggol seizes the opportunity to take Mokang's last dance. Not long after, however, another group of uninvited guests arrives and interrupts the merrymaking.

videos.title: Against
videos.overview: Tanggol's group chases after the Tondo gang while exchanging gunfire, unaware that Rigor and Mando are also hot on their trail. Later, Marites gets caught in the middle of another heated argument between Rigor and Tindeng.

videos.title: First Kiss
videos.overview: Mokang finds herself dreaming about her dance with Tanggol. After managing to escape from the police, the Tondo gang vows to take revenge on Tanggol's group. Meanwhile, Mokang's schoolmates plot against her.

videos.title: Charge
videos.overview: Tindeng stands firm in her decision to leave the Dimaguibas' house. The vindictive Tondo gang sets out to collect money from Edwin. Things go downhill for Rigor as the higher-ups finally reach a decision regarding his case.

videos.title: Warm Welcome
videos.overview: After pleading for his life to be spared, Edwin is forced to join the Tondo gang and help them carry out a robbery. The Montenegros head to Binondo for a meeting with the Chinese triad, only to receive an unexpected welcome.

videos.title: Mokang's Plea
videos.overview: The Montenegros face their first obstacle in establishing a partnership with the Chinese triad. After the disaster at her debut, Mokang tries to apologize to her schoolmates with all her might, only to be confronted with a much bigger consequence.

videos.title: Trouble at School
videos.overview: Tanggol and his friends head to Mokang's school in an effort to ask for her forgiveness. Mokang, on the other hand, unknowingly gets lured into JP's trap. The Montenegros stand firm in their decision to take over Quiapo no matter what it takes.

videos.title: Hijack
videos.overview: Greg and Olga talk about their plan ahead of Ramon's war against Amanda's faction. Supremo notices a familiar face as he leads his group in hijacking a delivery truck, unaware that it belongs to his archenemy.

videos.title: Drink
videos.overview: While Supremo contemplates the next steps in his revenge plan, Amanda and her group set out to capture their newest target. After successfully saving Mokang from danger, Tanggol confesses his real intentions toward the lady.

videos.title: Amanda's Strength
videos.overview: Both determined to wage war against the Commando group, Supremo and Ramon find ways to gather more information about Amanda's power and influence. Later, Augustus gets wind of some shocking news.

videos.title: Going Home
videos.overview: Marites starts to feel the weight of her family members' absence. Augustus grows suspicious of Amanda after learning about Supremo's release from prison. Lena grabs her chance to get closer to Rigor.

videos.title: Night of Temptation
videos.overview: After a night of drinking, Lena and David end up taking care of an intoxicated Rigor and Camille, respectively. Tanggol, meanwhile, thinks of ways on how to make his feelings reach Mokang.

videos.title: Lies
videos.overview: Mokang dreams about Tanggol and recalls her memories with him. Tanggol, on the other hand, receives love advice from Tindeng. Rigor and Camille both wake up stunned by the previous night's happenings.

videos.title: Opportunities
videos.overview: Tanggol and his grandparents learn about Rigor's suspension. Tolits and Tala come home with an unexpected companion. Augustus inches closer to his goal of reigning over Manila through his position in the government.

videos.title: Extension
videos.overview: Olga takes the chance to plot against Ramon while he is out of the country. Wanting to ensure Mokang's safety, Tanggol's group volunteers to escort her to school. Marcing and Nita struggle to find a way to pay their increasing debt to Roda.

videos.title: Expel
videos.overview: Lena continues her attempts to seduce Rigor. Marcing learns of an easy way to gather money. Trouble welcomes Mokang back to school as JP, Sarah, and their friends frame her up, putting her scholarship in jeopardy.

videos.title: New Business
videos.overview: Greg takes advantage of Ramon's absence to kick-start their illegal drug business in Quiapo, while Amanda receives a demanding request from the Chinese triad. Tanggol and his friends try to console Mokang, oblivious to what awaits them back home.

videos.title: Wanted
videos.overview: While Tanggol and his friends try to recruit Mokang, news about the police complaint against them slowly reaches their respective families. David confronts Rigor about the latter's infidelity.

videos.title: Fighting Fairly
videos.overview: Worse comes to worst for Tanggol and his friends as Mokang's family takes out their anger on them, followed by Rigor who is bent on hunting them down. With nowhere else to go, Tanggol is forced to take refuge in an old friend.

videos.title: In Tanggol's New Life
videos.overview: Augustus receives unpleasant news about his promotion, while Supremo plots to sabotage the Commando group's big drug transaction. With the help of Berting, Tanggol and his friends take their first attempt at turning over a new leaf.

videos.title: Marriage and Divorce
videos.overview: While their respective families continue to search for them, Mokang, Tanggol, and their friends make a fresh start by taking on a decent job. The Red Phoenix group proceeds with the wedding celebration, unaware of Augustus' and Supremo's next moves.

videos.title: At the Start of the War
videos.overview: While Amanda loses face in front of Angkong after Supremo spoiled their deal, Ramon gets the opportunity to be of service to the Chinese triad. Following a heated argument, Marites and Tindeng end up having a heart-to-heart talk.

videos.title: Raid
videos.overview: Turning over a new leaf proves to be challenging for Tanggol and his friends as conflict arises at work. Following Augustus' order, the authorities raid the triads' wedding.

videos.title: When Father and Son Meet
videos.overview: Tanggol gets hold of a valuable item after his group's unexpected gunfight with Greg's and the police. Ramon, meanwhile, inches closer to finding his son as he catches a glimpse of Tanggol. The Tondo gang officially welcomes a new member.

videos.title: The Lost Son
videos.overview: Tindeng and Noy's return to the Dimaguiba household draws mixed reactions from their family. While Tanggol's group struggles to deal with Ramon's high-grade drugs, the Montenegro heir finds renewed interest in searching for his long-lost son.

videos.title: Spy
videos.overview: Amanda discovers the identity of the mastermind behind the sabotage of her drug transaction with Angkong. The Dimaculangans face the consequences of their unpaid debt to Roda. Tanggol and Mokang plan to go back to Quiapo.

videos.title: Mound
videos.overview: Olga moves to get ahead of Ramon in finding his son. Together with Edwin, the Tondo gang begins their hunt for Tanggol anew. Marsing resorts to a dangerous way to gather money for his family's debt.

videos.title: Beaten
videos.overview: Marites comes across a familiar face. Supremo's message demanding ransom money for the drugs reaches Amanda and Augustus. Tanggol suffers at the hands of the Tondo gang.

videos.title: Recovery and Tragedy
videos.overview: The Dimaculangans' world comes crashing down when they learn about Marsing's tragic accident. While Tanggol gets the chance to recover and reflect after getting beaten up, Ramon remains determined in finding his long-lost son once and for all.

videos.title: The Return to the Past
videos.overview: Sensing Mokang's desperation to earn money for her father's hospital bills, Chicky offers a risky way to solve her friend's problems. Ramon goes back to the place where it all started as he searches high and low for the next Montenegro heir.

videos.title: Method
videos.overview: Learning that Augustus is harassing his family, Angkong decides to seek Ramon's help. Olga continues to sabotage her brother's search for his son. Tension rises anew in the Dimaguiba household as Marites informs Rigor of Tanggol's plight.

videos.title: If the Plan is to Surrender
videos.overview: The Dimaguibas learn the truth about Tanggol's conflict with the Tondo gang. While Ramon takes a great interest in Rigor, Olga scrambles to find her brother's son. Tanggol prepares to surrender the syndicate's drugs to his father.

videos.title: Rush
videos.overview: Unaware of her husband's ulterior motive, Marites heaves a sigh of relief when Rigor agrees to help Tanggol. As Ramon gains an important lead in his search for his son, Greg heads to Quiapo to get rid of the long-lost Montenegro heir.

videos.title: Instant Clash in Quiapo
videos.overview: Greg terrorizes the Dimaguiba household in search for Ramon's son, endangering the lives of Tanggol's family. A bloody gunfight ensues shortly after as Tanggol and Greg's conflict comes to a head.

videos.title: Worries and Dreams
videos.overview: Tindeng notices something strange about one of Rigor's colleagues as the police come to the Dimaguibas' rescue. The Dimaculangans face the severity of Marsing's condition. A tragic news shakes Olga to the core.

videos.title: Twins of Misfortune
videos.overview: After their harrowing experience, Tanggol's group receives serious scolding from Berting for their reckless actions. While Ramon believes that there is more to Greg's tragic fate in Quiapo, Olga vows to avenge her son.

videos.title: As for Olga's Revenge
videos.overview: Olga wastes no time in setting her revenge plans against the Montenegros in motion as she mourns Greg's death. Determined to set things straight, Tanggol goes back home in an attempt to surrender the drugs to the right person once and for all.

videos.title: Eviction
videos.overview: Tanggol comes to Mokang's rescue anew as Roda attempts to drive the Dimaculangans out of their house. Following Ramon's order to find out the whole truth behind the shootout, Severino goes back to Quiapo and later spots a familiar item.

videos.title: Desperation
videos.overview: Edwin seeks the help of the Tondo gang to exact revenge on Roda for ruining his family's life. Ramon's briefcase containing high-grade drugs finally reaches Rigor. Despite the risks, Mokang resorts to a desperate measure to earn easy money.

videos.title: First Night
videos.overview: While the Dimaguibas try to slowly get back on their feet after the life-threatening incident at home, a distressed David faces a huge problem of his own. Mokang starts working at Chicky's job, much to Tanggol's displeasure.

videos.title: Edwin's Revenge on Roda
videos.overview: The Tondo gang formally welcomes Edwin to their group ahead of their plan against Roda. Tanggol struggles to keep a cool head as he watches Mokang take on a risky job. Ramon obtains significant information about his briefcase and his lost son.

videos.title: Jealousy and Fear
videos.overview: Edwin's guilty conscience starts to haunt him. Olga attempts to act on her deep-rooted grudge against the Montenegros. Filled with jealousy, Tanggol disregards all reason and takes matters into his own hands.

videos.title: Money, Life or Heart
videos.overview: Despite Tanggol's pure intention, Mokang confronts him for jeopardizing her work at the club, only to fall prey to Banjo's lecherous advances. Nita grows suspicious of her children's means of gathering money for Marsing's hospital bills.

videos.title: Ambush
videos.overview: David tries to make things right with Camille. After straining his relationship with Mokang yet again, Tanggol resolves to earnestly change his ways for the better. Rigor moves to surrender the drugs, oblivious to the lurking enemy's plot.

videos.title: Honesty is From the Start
videos.overview: Tanggol's group sets out to look for a decent job. An unexpected customer tries to gain Marites and her family's trust. After learning about Augustus' promotion, Supremo moves to finally take revenge on his archenemy.

videos.title: Work
videos.overview: Despite their determination, Tanggol and his friends find it hard to get people's acceptance and secure a job. With the help of Mama Janet, Mokang manages to enter a new club to work at. Supremo and Augustus gear up for their bloody transaction.

videos.title: Change
videos.overview: Supremo's long-awaited day finally arrives as his gang faces the Commando group in a violent confrontation. Tanggol and his friends manage to get decent jobs but soon find themselves caught up in another mess.

videos.title: Face to Face
videos.overview: Ramon takes matters into his own hands after Severino failed to retrieve Rigor and the briefcase. David and Camille decide to come clean to the latter's parents about their relationship. Supremo confronts Amanda for her betrayal.

videos.title: Everyone
videos.overview: Mokang catches the eye of a high-paying regular at the club, leaving her faced with a new challenge. Left with no other choice, David takes Camille to his home. Tanggol's group struggles to get out of another mess they got into.

videos.title: Pretense and Love
videos.overview: Emotions run high in the Dimaguiba household as David opens up about Camille's condition. Supremo's group plans to use Amanda against Augustus, unaware that the enemy is moving to hunt them down.

videos.title: Desperate
videos.overview: David's true colors begin to show as his family's troubles involving Camille pile up, while Marites is forced to seek financial help from a newfound friend. Rigor learns about the recent attack against Roda upon his reinstatement.

videos.title: There's a Right and an Opponent in the House
videos.overview: To prove her worth at the club, Mokang is forced to do a showdown with Selene. Olga inches closer to gaining Marites' trust. Tanggol and his friends find themselves in yet another dangerous situation when Augustus ambushes Supremo's hideout.

videos.title: Abduct
videos.overview: David finds himself in danger as Olga does everything in her power to get hold of Tanggol. While the Tondo gang pursues a new venture, Roda regains consciousness in the hospital. Tanggol brings the injured Supremo and his men to Berting's place.

videos.title: Showdown
videos.overview: Despite getting another scolding from Berting, Tanggol begs the ex-police officer to help the wounded criminals. Mokang faces Selene in a dance showdown. Augustus brings Amanda back home but remains suspicious of her after rescuing her from Supremo.

videos.title: There's a Bad Plan
videos.overview: Enraged over the aftermath of their catfight, Selene resolves to find a way to expel Mokang from the club. While Rigor remains troubled about the drugs, Colonel Suarez receives an order from a higher-up. Olga sets David free with a threat.

videos.title: Apprehended
videos.overview: Ramon manages to bring the family business back and running in time for his heir's arrival, but Olga has a different plan in mind. Augustus plots his next move against Supremo. Friction sparks between Mokang and Edwin anew.

videos.title: The Department of Compensation and Billing
videos.overview: Using the money she secretly borrowed from Beng, Marites pays for Camille's hospital bill. While her brother remains suspicious of her, Olga prepares her plan against Ramon. Selene discovers something to use against Mokang.

videos.title: Entire System of the Heart
videos.overview: Tanggol tries to reconcile with Berting as he plans to go back to Quiapo. Edwin and his gang continue their drug dealings, while Ramon relocates his business for security. Amanda struggles to get in touch with Primo under Augustus' watchful eye.

videos.title: Visit
videos.overview: Olga's evil plans prove to be unstoppable as she stages a commotion to force her way into the Dimaguibas' lives. News about the authorities hunting him down greets Tanggol upon his return home. David receives an unwanted visitor at the hospital.

videos.title: Wanted
videos.overview: Olga continues her pretense in front of Marites while keeping a tight hold on David. The Red Phoenix group is set free through Ramon's machinations. Later, tension builds when Tanggol and David cross paths.

videos.title: Anomaly
videos.overview: Rigor starts to suspect a connivance between his superiors concerning the drugs he turned over. Tanggol heads to Scorpia to ask for Mokang's forgiveness. The Red Phoenix group agrees to work under the Montenegros on one condition.

videos.title: To the Savior
videos.overview: News about Tanggol being the main suspect in Roda's case reaches the Dimaguibas and Dimaculangans. Ramon visits Scorpia and immediately takes a liking to Mokang, oblivious to the identity of his greatest rival to the lady.

videos.title: Serenade
videos.overview: While David earns back his father's trust and reconciles with him, Rigor threatens his family after discovering that they have been covering up for Tanggol. Tanggol, meanwhile, makes his date with Mokang extra special with a romantic gesture.

videos.title: Hope
videos.overview: Tanggol confesses his love for Mokang once again and vows to protect her, but the troubled woman remains torn between her feelings and her responsibilities. Supremo sets his sights on taking back Amanda from Augustus once he and his men recover.

videos.title: Accusation
videos.overview: Nita's warning about Tanggol further complicates Mokang's feelings toward him and his confession. Determined to know the truth behind his accusation against Tanggol, Marites visits Roda and later makes a significant discovery.

videos.title: Visitor
videos.overview: Olga notices a mysterious woman on her tail as she makes her way to the Dimaguibas. Tanggol's group sets out to look for a new job in Binondo. Selene considers a more devious way to get rid of her rival when Mokang gets requested by a client.

videos.title: News about the Spy
videos.overview: Supremo tails Amanda and vows to get her back from Augustus, while the crime lord moves to find out who Angkong's new backer is. Tanggol's group resorts to a crafty way to secure a job. Olga prepares a deceitful birthday gift for Ramon.

videos.title: There's Still a New Word
videos.overview: Amanda sneaks away from her group to meet with Supremo. Augustus visits the Quiapo precinct to endorse two new officers. Tanggol and his friends succeed in getting new jobs, only for the former to get into another trouble.

videos.title: Buy-Bust
videos.overview: Under their new officers' leadership, Rigor and his colleagues wage war on drugs in Quiapo, putting Edwin and the Tondo gang's illicit business at risk and causing a conflict in their group. Tanggol shows interest in Roy's job offer.

videos.title: To the Missing Drug
videos.overview: Rigor makes an important discovery upon investigating the drugs that he turned over to Col. Suarez. Unwanted guests arrive at Scorpia, putting Mokang and Mama Janet's lives in danger.

videos.title: With a Longer Tail
videos.overview: After coming to Mokang's rescue, Tanggol decides to follow her to her job to ensure her safety. Amanda faces Augustus' wrath as he warns her against betraying him. Olga prepares to surprise Ramon at his birthday party.

videos.title: Gift
videos.overview: Edwin continues his drug dealings despite the conflict within the Tondo gang, unaware that he is close to getting busted. Tanggol and his friends sneak into Ramon's party, only to be caught off guard by Mokang's special performance.

videos.title: In Confession
videos.overview: Tanggol's group comes across a kidnapping scene and decides to intervene, unaware of the real situation. After her performance, Mokang privately meets with Ramon upon his request and gets stunned with a shocking offer.

videos.title: Child
videos.overview: Mokang rejects Ramon’s marriage proposal, pushing the mob boss to tread the longer road and win over the troubled woman’s heart. Later, Ramon vehemently refuses to believe that the man Olga brought before him is his son.

videos.title: Living in a Dangerous Situation
videos.overview: While Olga tries to convince Ramon that she just wants to get along with him, David sets his sights on inheriting the Montenegros’ wealth. Tanggol grows troubled upon learning that Mokang considers selling her body in a bid to save Marsing.

videos.title: Assurance
videos.overview: Tanggol and his friends think of every possible way to help Mokang gather money for her father's operation, while Supremo and his men make up their minds to find a job. Following Ramon's order, Olga arranges a DNA test for David.

videos.title: Filch
videos.overview: Still challenging Edwin’s influence, Kidlat pilfers a considerable sum from his group’s earnings. Rigor confronts Colonel Suarez about the questionable disappearance of the briefcase containing seized illegal drugs.

videos.title: Result
videos.overview: Tanggol refuses to go back to their previous way of living despite Enteng's insistence. The Red Phoenix group prepares for its operation with Ramon. Ramon, meanwhile, finally receives David's DNA test results.

videos.title: To the Fake Tanggol's Defense
videos.overview: A brawl ensues after Edwin confronted Kidlat for stealing from their group’s earnings. Tears flow as Mokang vows to do everything to save Marsing. Ramon remains doubtful despite seeing the paternity test result.

videos.title: Delivery Boy
videos.overview: Tanggol and Enteng brim with joy when Roy hires them as delivery boys, unaware of the real danger behind their simple task. Olga warns David against underestimating Ramon.

videos.title: In Double Doubt
videos.overview: Olga seizes another opportunity to use Marites' predicament to her advantage. Tanggol and Enteng successfully earn Roy's trust, only to realize soon after the alarming reality of their newfound job.

videos.title: The Piles of Money
videos.overview: While accompanying Supremo and his men who are looking for a decent job, Berting crosses paths with an old colleague. Determined to help Mokang financially, Tanggol heeds Enteng's risky suggestion.

videos.title: Rescue
videos.overview: Primo finds an opportunity to rescue Amanda when Berting alerts the police about an ongoing drug trade. A heated argument ensues at the Dimaguiba household anew because of David's arrogance. Mokang meets with Ramon for a date.

videos.title: Date
videos.overview: Tindeng blames Rigor for inflating David’s ego by being unfair to his other children. Luis poses as a buyer in a bid to find out the Tondo gang’s drug supplier. While dining at a fancy restaurant, Ramon reminds Mokang that his offer still stands.

videos.title: Hiding
videos.overview: After learning who Amanda is, Berting lashes out at Supremo for dragging him into deeper trouble. Aiming to steal the drug money he recently delivered, Tanggol infiltrates the Chinese syndicate’s mansion.

videos.title: Escape
videos.overview: Amanda resolves to make a huge sacrifice to help Supremo defeat Augustus once and for all. A shootout ensues as the Red Phoenix group hunts down Tanggol and his friends. Left with no other choice, Mokang gives herself to Ramon.

videos.title: Praise
videos.overview: Roy and his men continue to chase Tanggol's group, with Rigor and the police force on their tail. Later, Tanggol offers Mokang the money he stole to fund Marsing's operation, only to get stunned by a devastating discovery about the woman he loves.

videos.title: No Fight
videos.overview: Augustus pulls up a wicked trick up his sleeve to lure Amanda, while Supremo plans for his next move. Tanggol comes face-to-face with Rigor amid the bloody shootout between the police and the Quiapo delinquents.

videos.title: On the Brink of Dying
videos.overview: Tanggol ends up fighting for his life in the hospital, while his friends find themselves in jail. After hearing about the shocking news, Marites and Tindeng rush to confront Rigor for his unforgivable deed.

videos.title: Operation
videos.overview: Mokang sheds tears as she fervently prays while Marsing undergoes a delicate surgery and Tanggol remains unconscious due to his injuries. Despite Richardson’s opposition, the Red Phoenix group decides to inform Ramon of the burglary incident.

videos.title: Far from Danger
videos.overview: Regaining consciousness moments after Augustus arrived at the hospital, Tanggol resolves to face the consequences of his decisions. The Dimaculangans learn that Marsing will need more time to fully recover.

videos.title: Engaged
videos.overview: Marites and Tindeng grow concerned as the authorities escort Tanggol to the police station for booking and interrogation. Nita is left in disbelief upon learning about the thing Mokang sacrificed in order to save Marsing.

videos.title: Jail
videos.overview: While Tanggol gets brutally interrogated by the police, the Red Phoenix group plots against him upon learning of his arrest. Much to Col. Suarez's distress, Augustus seizes the drugs confiscated from Tanggol.

videos.title: Visit
videos.overview: The Dimaguibas' problems pile up when Roda arrives at the precinct vowing to file another serious case against Tanggol's group. Later, Mokang steels herself as she pays Tanggol a visit.

videos.title: Compromise
videos.overview: As Tindeng worries about her grandchild, Marites fears that Tanggol’s future has been ruined beyond repair. David learns from Julio that Ramon is on his way back to the mansion with his wife-to-be.

videos.title: The Corpse at the River
videos.overview: Olga sends David back home. Tanggol slumps in deep dejection as he begins to accept the reality that he lost his chance of having a better future. Amanda fears for her parents’ lives when one of her relatives is found lifeless on a riverbank.

videos.title: Escape
videos.overview: While Primo and Berting infiltrate Augustus’ territory, Amanda stays out of sight as she escorts her parents to safety with the help of her loyal men. Tanggol receives an unexpected visitor.

videos.title: Family and Peace
videos.overview: Tanggol laments his estranged relationship with David and Rigor, prompting his friends to doubt his kinship with them. Primo's group and Amanda suffer the terrible consequences of going against Augustus.

videos.title: Newcomers
videos.overview: Ramon and Don Julio agree to use the former’s new identity as the Dimaculangans begin settling in their mansion. Tindeng and Rigor get into a heated argument about Tanggol’s predicament.

videos.title: Fear
videos.overview: Augustus orders Col. Suarez to teach Primo and Berting a lesson they will never forget. Despite fearing for her family’s safety, Amanda refuses to give her loyalty to her husband. Marites tries to talk some sense into David.

videos.title: Hug
videos.overview: Following a heart-to-heart, Marites dissuades Santino from pursuing his dream of becoming a boxer. Rigor spends the night at Lena’s house. Tanggol receives a hug from a vengeful woman hiding behind a mask of charity and kindness.

videos.title: Verdict
videos.overview: Olga vows to make Tanggol pay for killing Greg. Augustus uses Primo’s bloodied clothes in a hopes of bringing Amanda back to his fold. The police escort Tanggol and his friends to court to face trial.

videos.title: Convict
videos.overview: Rigor sees himself on the bad side of Augustus' minions for voicing out his concern for Primo's group. Olga asks a favor from her connection just before Tanggol and his friends arrive at the penitentiary.

videos.title: Welcome
videos.overview: After getting a violent welcome from his cellmates, Tanggol (Coco Martin) sees a familiar face inside the prison. Olga (Irma Adlawan) resolves to nip the problems Mokang (Lovi Poe) brought in the bud. Ramon (Christopher De Leon) formally introduces himself to Marsing (Pen Medina) and Nita (Susan Africa).

videos.title: Wedding Flowers
videos.overview: While secretly executing her schemes against Ramon’s son, Olga sets in motion her plan to prevent his brother from marrying Mokang. Tanggol and his friends receive blood-curdling news.

videos.title: Grief and Celebration
videos.overview: Mando grows concerned as Rigor and Lena’s relationship deepens. David flirts with a woman at a club. Tindeng and Marites are shaken to the core following the attempt on Tanggol’s life.

videos.title: Memory
videos.overview: Tindeng breaks down as she laments her grandson’s predicament. After a heated argument with Marites, Rigor assures David that their family will soon realize that they are in the right. Tanggol expresses his desire to stop Mokang’s wedding.

videos.title: Explosive
videos.overview: Marsing feels guilty for his daughter's sacrifice as Mokang's big day finally arrives. Tanggol continues to go through hell in prison. Ramon's wedding commences, unaware of Olga's wicked plot.

videos.title: Aftermath
videos.overview: Olga breaks out in a cold sweat as Ramon vows to make the life of the person behind the bombing a living hell. While Tanggol gets punished by Dolores, his friends are left with no choice but to push through with their plan to break out of prison.

videos.title: Termination
videos.overview: David starts cheating on Camille. Ramon informs the Dimaculangans that he and Mokang will leave the mansion for a time to stay somewhere safer. Seeing a potential in Tanggol, Dolores asks Bubbles to prepare a meal to help the newcomer recover.

videos.title: The Gossipers
videos.overview: Aiming to fix his family, Rigor imposes a house rule that prevents every single one of them from paying Tanggol a visit. While Ramon and Mokang enjoy their honeymoon, Tanggol unknowingly attracts trouble in prison.

videos.title: On Bong's Threat
videos.overview: Bong warns Bubbles that he will make Tanggol and his friends pay if she approaches the newcomers again. Severino catches Edwin snooping around Ramon’s private room, helping Olga convince Don Julio to keep a close watch on the Dimaculangans.

videos.title: Replacement
videos.overview: Augustus gears up for his cold-blooded plan against Supremo. While Tanggol and his friends familiarize themselves with the people at the penitentiary, Bong's group earns Dolores' ire.

videos.title: New Trustee
videos.overview: While Bubbles informs Tanggol about his responsibilities as one of Dolores’ so-called trustees, Warden Balacutan punishes Bong’s group. Primo tells Rigor that Augustus is planning to kill him during his transfer to another prison.

videos.title: Work
videos.overview: Tindeng fumes with rage upon seeing the poster Roda made. Augustus and Col. Suarez try to convince Rigor to accept his promotion. While searching for work, Santino learns from Kap that there is a boxing coach nearby.

videos.title: Forgetting
videos.overview: Roda catches the interest of Kidlat’s group. Santino lands a job as a janitor at a boxing gym. Still not visited by their loved ones, Tanggol and his friends cannot help but think that their families have forgotten them.

videos.title: Shortcoming
videos.overview: Augustus tells Amanda that she has no other choice but to choose him following Primo’s supposed death. Dolores gives Bong a warning and an assassination order. Tanggol’s heart grows heavy as he recalls how he lost the love of his life.

videos.title: Caught on the Spot
videos.overview: Primo's group decides to find a place and seek refuge in the meantime, while Augustus is still occupied with Amanda. Don Julio showers David with gifts. Noy comes across a sophisticated-looking Beng.

videos.title: Fire
videos.overview: Teban agrees to help Kidlat steal the large sum of money Roda withdrew from the bank. Despite coach Daryl’s warnings, Santino remains adamant about pursuing his dream of becoming a professional boxer.

videos.title: In His Hideout
videos.overview: As Roda laments the destruction of all his possessions, Kidlat hands Edwin a peace offering. Tanggol and his friends receive food from Elsa. Augustus lashes out at his men for failing to kill Primo.

videos.title: The Visitor and Suspicion
videos.overview: Colonel Suarez rebukes Roda for rushing him into finding the men behind the burglary. Mulong comes up with a plan to smoke Primo out. Failing to resist his curiosity, Marsing sneaks a close look at Don Julio’s business partners.

videos.title: Call
videos.overview: Olga urges Don Julio to convince Ramon to transfer Mokang’s family to another house. Mokang sees her husband’s dangerous side when she gets harassed by two men at the resort. Bubbles learns why Dolores wants her to keep an eye on Tanggol.

videos.title: Vagrancy
videos.overview: David decides to engage in a road gig with his side chick, only to be caught red-handed by Rigor's comrades-in-arms. A bloody riot erupts at the penitentiary involving Tanggol's friends and Bong's fold.

videos.title: Revenge
videos.overview: Tanggol starts to see red after watching his friends fall one after another. Berting resolves to help Primo save Amanda as he vows to take down corrupt policemen like Augustus. Ramon apologizes to Mokang for focusing too much on his family business.

videos.title: Space
videos.overview: Marites grows worried as she waits for Rigor to return home. Bong and his friends get into their positions as they attempt to assassinate their high-profile target. Bubbles reprimands Tanggol for getting involved in the prison fight.

videos.title: Friend
videos.overview: Dolores decides to replace Bong’s group with the newcomers if her current contract killers fail to assassinate their target. Tanggol fears for his friends’ lives as he awaits his punishment. Tindeng confronts Rigor over the latter’s harsh house rule.

videos.title: New Mission, Old Ways
videos.overview: Heeding Chicky’s advice, Mokang comes up with a way to reciprocate her husband’s efforts. After Bong’s failure to finish off his target, Dolores reaches a decision that is set to change Tanggol’s life.

videos.title: Moving to a New House
videos.overview: Olga convinces Don Julio to let David handle their business in the meantime, unaware that Ramon is about to return from his honeymoon. Roda wallows in misery as he moves into the Dimaculangans' old house. Tanggol gets a bad news from Dolores.

videos.title: Secret
videos.overview: Rigor admits that he is at peace whenever he is with Lena. Noy urges Tindeng to understand Marites’ situation. While Marsing and Nita tell Edwin about their suspicions about Albert’s family, Ramon and Mokang arrive home.

videos.title: Gift
videos.overview: Knowing how much Mokang loves her family, Ramon gives the Dimaculangans a car and a large sum of money to help them start a business. Santino watches coach Gary’s training sessions while working at the boxing gym.

videos.title: News and Threat
videos.overview: Yolly comes up with a way to help Primo check Amanda’s condition at the hospital. Ramon asks Mokang to buy her parents new clothes. Tanggol’s friends grow worried upon learning that Owen is still fighting for his life.

videos.title: New Life or Friend?
videos.overview: Primo and his allies go out of their hiding place to find and buy materials for their next mission. Olga plans to use Mokang in her contingency plan. Dolores finds a way to make Tanggol follow her orders.

videos.title: Wheel of Fate
videos.overview: Mokang's anticipation of meeting her husband's son grows as Ramon and Don Julio leave for their appointment with David. Marsing and Nita set foot in Quiapo again. Tanggol faces a dilemma.

videos.title: New Look
videos.overview: After getting even with Roda, Marsing vows to get back at the people who belittled and made his family suffer. Primo’s group heads out to check Amanda’s condition. Tanggol grows anxious as he and Bubbles prepare to accomplish Dolores’ mission.

videos.title: Closely Guarded
videos.overview: Marsing and Nita start lending money to their acquaintances in Quiapo. Tindeng cannot help but feel bad for Tanggol, thinking that Mokang has already turned her back on her grandson. Primo’s group infiltrates the hospital where Amanda is admitted.

videos.title: Just Work
videos.overview: After successfully getting near Amanda, Yolly assures the injured woman that Primo will return to save her. Col. Suarez forms a team to monitor the drug syndicate Luis is investigating. Bubbles lures Congressman Sevilla while Tanggol lurks behind.

videos.title: Weakling Not Allowed
videos.overview: Amanda vows to take Augustus down as she awaits Primo’s return. Ramon and Don Julio show David the front of their illegal business. Tanggol and Bubbles put their lives on the line as they hunt down their escaping target.

videos.title: Challenge
videos.overview: Following Don Julio's fatherly advice, Ramon spends some quality time with David in order to gain his favor. Tanggol and Bubbles attempt to make a getaway after their bloody mission.

videos.title: Hesitate
videos.overview: Gary urges his boxers to train harder as they are set to host Quiapo’s upcoming boxing tournament. Ramon and Don Julio’s meeting with the Red Phoenix group ends in a standoff. Dolores reaches a decision after Tanggol and Bubbles’ successful mission.

videos.title: First Round
videos.overview: Santino catches the attention of a retired boxer after showing great potential during his sparring with Chito. Determined to catch a big fish, Luis goes undercover and orders a large quantity of illegal drugs from Edwin.

videos.title: Reward
videos.overview: Olga tries to keep her cover intact as Tindeng confronts her for driving Noy away. Camille’s parents head to the police station to file charges against David for hurting their daughter. Dolores gives the nod to Tanggol’s requests.

videos.title: Reminder
videos.overview: Olga orders David to use the Feast of the Black Nazarene to fully convince Ramon that he is Tanggol. Tindeng chooses to help Roda, who is being clobbered down by a group of men, despite the horrible things he did to her family.

videos.title: Bad Intention
videos.overview: Roda is left with no choice but to swallow his pride as he decides to borrow money from Marsing and Nita. Dolores takes an interest in Tanggol's friends while they grow conflicted about their leader's mission.

videos.title: Give Away
videos.overview: Tanggol’s friends are shocked to learn that Bubbles is one of Dolores’ assassins. Just as she prepares to face Camille’s parents, Marites finds herself suppressing a gut feeling after spotting Rigor and Lena arriving at the police station together.

videos.title: Eve
videos.overview: Tindeng and Noy receive worrying news as their neighbors make last-minute preparations on the eve of the Feast of the Black Nazarene. Roy makes a risky move in a bid to pay the Red Phoenix group’s debt to Ramon.

videos.title: Impending Threat
videos.overview: Mokang expresses concern that her parents will end up like Roda due to their lending business. David lashes out at Camille for humiliating him in front of his family. Worried about Oweng, Tanggol and his friends hatch a plan.

videos.title: New Work
videos.overview: Ramon loses his temper when Mokang tries to pry into his problems, sparking a heated argument between Don Julio and his in-laws. Lamenting his son’s untimely death, Mr. Salazar puts a contract out on the members of the Red Phoenix group.

videos.title: Sample
videos.overview: An oblivious Edwin informs Justin about an incoming drug shipment, but not before a gunfight breaks out between the Tondo gang and the undercover cop's men. Tanggol receives his next mission from Dolores.

videos.title: Nightmares and Dreams
videos.overview: Marites and Ramon struggle to get a wink of sleep as disturbing images of the day their lives changed haunt their dreams. Lucio plans to use the Feast of the Black Nazarene to boost their chances of rescuing Amanda. Tanggol devises a risky plan.

videos.title: Feast of Quiapo
videos.overview: Bubbles dreams of sharing an intimate night with Tanggol. Colonel Suarez informs Augustus about their upcoming operation against a big drug syndicate. Primo’s group puts their plan to save Amanda into action.

videos.title: Escape
videos.overview: Primo and his friends deal with Augustus’ men as they rescue Amanda. Dolores sends Oweng to what she calls a special room, planning to use him to make Tanggol and his friends do her bidding.

videos.title: Obstruction
videos.overview: Olga uses her connections and cunning in a bid to force Don Julio and Ramon’s hand to show David the true nature of their business. Mando confronts Rigor about his affair with Lena. Bong confirms that Tanggol’s group has replaced them.

videos.title: Hint of Conscience
videos.overview: Rigor and Lena are thrown into a panic now that Mando knows about their affair. Mokang's apology falls on deaf ears as Tindeng and Marites chide her for marrying someone else. Bubbles warns Tanggol's group.

videos.title: Real Business
videos.overview: Ramon and Don Julio show David the real nature of their family business. The Red Phoenix group looks forward to meeting the Montenegros’ heir as they head to the factory to hand Ramon their payment, unaware of the danger they are stepping into.

videos.title: Preparing the Heir
videos.overview: David hides his true colors as Don Julio and Ramon give him a tour around their factory. Justin confirms the location of his target’s front company. Dolores keeps a close eye on Tanggol’s group as they tail the Red Phoenix Group.

videos.title: Victorious
videos.overview: With the help of Roberto’s coaching, Santino proves his mettle when he breaks Kamao Gym’s losing streak in the Nazarene Cup. Ramon considers finishing Edwin off upon spotting his brother-in-law inside his drug factory.

videos.title: Beginning of the Show
videos.overview: David comes up with a risky way to fully convince Ramon, Don Julio, and their business partners that he is Tanggol. As the police force gears up to raid the illegal drug factory, Tanggol’s group prepares to ambush the Red Phoenix group.

videos.title: Honesty
videos.overview: David takes the bullet for Ramon when an intense gunfight breaks out between the police and the Montenegros' force. Ramon finally finds an opportunity to settle the score with Rigor. Tanggol and Bubbles execute their mission.

videos.title: Break Free
videos.overview: After finding an opportunity to slip away from Rigor and Mando, Tanggol and Bubbles wade through heavy traffic, tight thoroughfares, and a sea of devotees as they try to escape from the police.

videos.title: Poultice
videos.overview: Rigor gets troubled after hearing Tanggol’s name during the shootout. Primo’s group uses the flock of devotees to their advantage in order to hide from Augustus’ men. Bubbles dissuades Tanggol from returning to prison as they remain at large.

videos.title: Consequent
videos.overview: David dupes Ramon into fully believing that he is Tanggol after taking advantage of the raid. Ramon, on the other hand, confirms that the police followed Edwin’s group to the factory. Tanggol and Bubbles arrive at a secluded resort.

videos.title: Scandal
videos.overview: Olga puts David back in his place as the latter gets cockier after successfully fooling Ramon. Tindeng and Noy spot Rigor and Lena eating sweetly together. Bubbles comes up with a way to hide her and Tanggol’s real identities at the resort.

videos.title: Rescue
videos.overview: Santino receives a piece of good news from Coach Gary after winning the Nazarene Cup. Mokang unconsciously calls for Tanggol's name as she finds herself in danger while roaming around her old neighborhood.

videos.title: True Color
videos.overview: Primo’s group returns to their hideout with Amanda after confirming that the coast is clear. Dolores remains on the edge as she awaits Tanggol and Bubbles' return. The Dimaculangans face Ramon’s burning fury upon their arrival at the mansion.

videos.title: The Truth
videos.overview: While Marsing and Nita are getting kicked out of the Montenegros' mansion, Ramon is forced to reveal his true identity to Mokang. Santino lies through his teeth when Marites notices his wounds.

videos.title: Extortion
videos.overview: Luis and Mario coerce Edwin to name the leader of the syndicate they were transacting with. Primo reveals his next steps after saving Amanda. Bubbles explains to Tanggol why they need to return to prison as soon as possible.

videos.title: Married Life
videos.overview: Tindeng confronts Rigor when the latter hands Marites the leftover from his date with Lena. Mokang sheds tears as she regrets wasting Tanggol's unrelenting love for her. Bubbles finally sees the gaping wound inside her partner’s heart.

videos.title: Bereavement
videos.overview: As she tries to ponder on the real score between Lena and Rigor, Marites urges Tindeng to refrain from worsening their situation. Celso and Tanggol's friends anxiously wait for the return of Dolores' hired assassins.

videos.title: Intrigue
videos.overview: Ramon refuses to let Mokang go, still blaming the Dimaculangans for the recent fiasco at their drug factory. David makes up an alibi in order to stay at the Montenegros’ mansion without worrying his family.

videos.title: Secret and Rescue
videos.overview: Marsing blackmails Roda after discovering his housemate’s secret. Mokang bursts into tears as she sees her parents being barred from entering the mansion. Bubbles’ clothes get stolen while she is skinny-dipping in the lake.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: Rigor finds it hard to let go of his suspicion that Tanggol was the one they encountered during the recent police operation. Accompanied by Primo’s group, Amanda travels to a remote part of the country in a bid to reunite with her parents.

videos.title: Tension
videos.overview: Tindeng and Noy find out that Marsing and Nita got kicked out of their in-laws’ mansion. Tension simmers at the police station as Marites tries to ask Lena pointed questions. Tanggol opens up to Bubbles before their inevitable return to prison.

videos.title: Threat of Danger
videos.overview: Tension ensues between Santino and Lawrence when the latter learns about the janitor's boxing training. While Tanggol and Bubbles make a promise to meet again in the future, Boston invites his police friends to his resort.

videos.title: Departure and Return
videos.overview: Santino and Annika grow closer as they train together at the gym. Primo convinces Amanda to relocate with him and her parents to a safer place. Tanggol makes a detour before returning to prison.

videos.title: Prayer
videos.overview: Tanggol’s friends get in trouble when Bong and his lackeys enflame Celso’s concern for Bubbles. Ramon catches Mokang attempting to escape from her confinement. Tanggol asks Bubbles for another favor after praying outside the Quiapo Church.

videos.title: Secret Visitor
videos.overview: Lawrence and Chito hatch a plot to get back at Santino. Marsing and Nita learn about the circulating rumor that Edwin got arrested during a police operation. Tanggol returns to the place where he grew up.

videos.title: Illusion
videos.overview: Sneaking into his family’s house, longing fills Tanggol's heart when he sees Tindeng for the first time after getting imprisoned. Breaking under torture, Tanos reveals the place where he believes Tanggol went after getting separated from them.

videos.title: Help
videos.overview: Fearing for Mokang's life, Marsing refuses to throw Alberto under the bus just yet. Unaware that Macasantos is looking for them, Tanggol secretly extends help to his friends' family.

videos.title: Danger of Love
videos.overview: Lucio receives a call from Yolly, unaware that the woman he loves is in the hands of Augustus’ men. Tindeng wants to confirm her hunch that her grandson paid them a visit. Tanggol asks Bubbles another huge favor.

videos.title: Meeting at the Mansion
videos.overview: Primo’s group starts preparing and setting up traps as Augustus’ men head to their location. Rigor finds out that correctional facility officers drop by their community. Tanggol infiltrates the Montenegros’ mansion in search of Mokang.

videos.title: Answer to Prayer
videos.overview: The Tondo gang plans their escape as Edwin refuses to name the drug syndicate's leader despite receiving an enticing offer from the police. A gunfight ensues between Augustus' and Primo's forces. Tanggol seeks Beng's help in saving Mokang.

videos.title: Passion
videos.overview: Following an emotional reunion, Tanggol puts his neck on the line as he urges Mokang to run away with him. Olga, on the other hand, resolves to help the two escape to protect her schemes involving David.

videos.title: Victim of the Clash
videos.overview: Marsing and Nita confront Roda for exposing their family's situation to their neighbors. The gunfight between Augustus' and Primo's forces results in a significant loss for Amanda. Tanggol, Mokang, and Bubbles seek temporary refuge.

videos.title: Privilege
videos.overview: Marsing gets forced to ask Roda for help due to his family's financial struggles. Rigor suspects that Tanggol escaped from jail and is doing something illegal again. Tanggol, on the other hand, seeks to clear up past misunderstandings with Mokang.

videos.title: Judgement
videos.overview: Bubbles fails to hide her jealousy as Tanggol and Mokang talk privately inside their room. Tanggol heeds the call of his heart as he arrives at a dicey decision about his current situation.

videos.title: Rift
videos.overview: Grieving for her parents' untimely death, Amanda finds the courage to put up a fight against Augustus. Trouble follows Bubbles when she decides to drown her sorrows.

videos.title: Grandson
videos.overview: Rigor burns with rage after foiling Tindeng and Noy’s plan to visit his wayward son in prison. Tanggol and Mokang wake up in each other’s arms, unaware of the danger heading their way.

videos.title: Eternal Danger
videos.overview: Rigor instructs Marites to keep an eye on Tindeng. While Gen. Espinas imposes heavy consequences on them if they fail to return on time, Tanggol and Bubbles try to escape from Ramon with Mokang.

videos.title: Side
videos.overview: While the rest of the group stands by Primo's side, Lucio decides to part ways with them as Amanda blames Yolly for her parents' deaths. Tindeng and Marites argue when the latter discovers more of what her mother has been keeping from her.

videos.title: Pursuit of Truth
videos.overview: Marites confirms that Tindeng and Noy are hiding something important from her after learning that Myrna received a large sum from Enteng. Tanggol, Mokang, and Bubbles board a train as they try to run away from Ramon and his men.

videos.title: Last Station
videos.overview: Lawrence's animosity toward Santino intensifies upon seeing the janitor interacting with Annika at the gym. While Tanggol refuses to leave Mokang behind, Olga creeps in with a different plan in mind.

videos.title: Monique
videos.overview: Santino and Lawrence vie to become Kamao Gym’s sole representative in the upcoming invitational cup. Mando warns Rigor that Marites is growing suspicious of his relationship with Lena. The dangerous chase between Ramon and Tanggol ends in a tragedy.

videos.title: Farewell
videos.overview: As Ramon returns home unaware of Monique's whereabouts following the shootout, Olga puts on a concerned facade and keeps the truth even from David. Tanggol vows to avenge Mokang's death as he lays his most beloved woman to rest.

videos.title: Back to Jail
videos.overview: Ramon vows to move heaven and earth to find and reclaim Mokang. Dolores panics when Rigor and Mando visit the correctional facility to investigate the recent raid in Quiapo, unaware that Tanggol and Bubbles have already returned.

videos.title: Tears
videos.overview: Despite his granddaughter’s assurance, Celso refuses to let Bubbles be deployed with Tanggol on future assassination missions. Dolores tries to maintain a stern facade as Rigor tries to confirm his hunch.

videos.title: Caused by Tragedy
videos.overview: As the Montenegros relocate to a new safe house, an oblivious Ramon sets his sights on finding the man who took Mokang away from him. Dolores asks Bubbles about her and Tanggol's disappearance.

videos.title: Command
videos.overview: After pouring his anger out on his henchmen, Ramon orders Severino to find Mokang and the man who took his wife away. Rigor and Mando convince Col. Suarez to let them investigate Dolores. Tanggol returns to his cell, unaware of Bong’s schemes.

videos.title: Speechless
videos.overview: David continues to enjoy his lavish life with the Montenegros. As the arraignment for their drug case approaches, Teban and Kidlat convince Edwin to join their plan. Tanggol's friends notice his unusual behavior upon his return.

videos.title: Repentance
videos.overview: Despite having differences with Amanda, Lucio agrees to accompany Primo one last time. Bong acquires much-needed weapons as his group gears up for their escape. While Bubbles opens up to her friends, Enteng checks up on a troubled Tanggol.

videos.title: Foreboding and Truth
videos.overview: Don Julio’s effort to help Ramon forget Mokang backfires as his son continues to drown himself in misery. Not wanting his brother to get into more trouble, Santino dissuades Marites from informing Rigor about Tanggol’s presumed visit.

videos.title: Mourning
videos.overview: The Tondo gang remains determined to push through with their escape plan despite Edwin's offer of helping them through his lawyer. Marites asks Mando about Rigor's allegations against Tanggol.

videos.title: Mother to Mother
videos.overview: Tindeng’s heart breaks as Marites begins to doubt that Tanggol can change for the better. Rigor vows to make his unruly son pay if he confirms his suspicions about the illegal operations in the penitentiary. Tanggol requests to talk to Dolores.

videos.title: Loss of Hope
videos.overview: Rigor informs David about his allegations against Tanggol. While Olga plans to visit the penitentiary to confirm the information she got from David, Tanggol remains determined to avenge Mokang.

videos.title: Sympathy
videos.overview: Primo’s group makes a distraction in a bid to give Amanda a chance to steal the money in Augustus’ coffers. Bong’s gang prepares their weapons right under Dolores’ nose. Bubbles grows concerned for Tanggol as she recalls her partner’s hardships.

videos.title: Brewing Hatred
videos.overview: Yolly puts her life on the line to save her friends from Mulong’s group, unaware that her noble sacrifice will widen the gap between Primo and Lucio. Failing to rein in her unease, Bubbles pays Tanggol a visit.

videos.title: Good Friend
videos.overview: Bubbles’ words of encouragement fall on deaf ears as Tanggol remains adamant about getting back at the person who killed Mokang. Lucio lashes out at Primo, blaming his long-time friend for Yolly’s demise.

videos.title: Investigation
videos.overview: Rigor starts sniffing for clues around Quiapo after learning about Tanggol’s supposed visit. Before his friend’s release from prison, Tanggol asks Ben a small favor.

videos.title: Revenge
videos.overview: Tanggol seeks Ben's help to exact revenge on Mokang's husband. While the Dimaculangans prepare for Edwin's arraignment, Ramon keeps a close watch on Nita and Marsing in hopes of finding Monique.

videos.title: Visit of the Past
videos.overview: Rigor and Mando gain a new lead in their investigation into the corruption within the penitentiary. Burning with jealousy, Bong forces himself on Bubbles. Olga visits an inmate in prison.

videos.title: Samantha
videos.overview: Tanggol’s friends ask Bubbles if she was there when Mokang died. Olga cannot help but remember the time Don Julio forced her to give up her daughter as she comes face-to-face with Celso.

videos.title: Transaction
videos.overview: After speaking with Celso, Olga is forced to bare her fangs when Dolores refuses to meet her demands. David finds himself in a tight spot after receiving tasks from Don Julio. Tanggol gets wind of Bong’s act of savagery against Bubbles.

videos.title: Retaliation
videos.overview: Tanggol makes Bong taste the depth of his wrath, starting a chain reaction that leads to a commotion in the prison. David tries to impress Don Julio and Ramon with the idea he got from Olga. Roy recalls the face of the man who attempted to end him.

videos.title: Slip Through
videos.overview: Ramon observes from a distance as David deals with an unexpected police checkpoint en route to a client. Santino prepares for his upcoming fight against Lawrence. Back at the correctional facility, Bubbles and Celso speak up to defend Tanggol.

videos.title: Fugitive
videos.overview: Lawrence raises the stakes involved in his fight against Santino. Chaos breaks out in court as the Tondo Gang executes their plan to escape, forcing Edwin to join the fray to save himself.

videos.title: Señora Bettina
videos.overview: Edwin, Teban, and Kidlat escape from the police. Trying to find a new lead, Rigor resolves to do a background check on Dolores and her lackeys. Tindeng and Noy save a rich woman named Bettina from two hoodlums.

videos.title: Santino's Fight
videos.overview: Rigor grows troubled upon getting wind of Lena’s request to get reassigned to a different precinct. Despite his opponent's dirty moves, Santino gives his all as he goes up against Lawrence. Celso holds out an olive branch to Tanggol.

videos.title: Caught
videos.overview: Rigor and Lena rekindle the dying flame between them, only to be caught red-handed by Noy and Tindeng. David panics when Ramon orders Severino to find valuable information about Mokang in Quiapo. Bong resolves execute his wicked plan.

videos.title: Complaint
videos.overview: While Lucio devises a plan to avenge Yolly's death, Ben reunites with Primo's group. Tindeng tells Marites about Rigor's infidelity, but the latter denies it and makes every effort to discredit his mother-in-law.

videos.title: Blindsided
videos.overview: Roda gets wind of Edwin’s escape. Olga warns David about the consequences of failing his mission to stop Severino from learning about Tanggol and Mokang’s relationship. Tindeng arrives at the police station to file a complaint against Rigor.

videos.title: Guns and Weapons
videos.overview: In a towering rage following the mess at the police station, Rigor blows a fuse and shoots the fear out of Tindeng. Opening up to Enteng, Tanggol feels that his life is useless, believing that his family has forsaken him.

videos.title: Support and Help
videos.overview: Severino resorts to violence as he fails to wring anything out of Marsing. Left with no other recourse, the Dimaculangans seek Rigor’s help, pushing David to make a move. Tanggol’s friends urge him to be vigilant, believing that Bong will retaliate.

videos.title: Hypocrisy
videos.overview: Bong’s group steals guns from the prison’s armory as they prepare to get back at Tanggol and Dolores. Still sniffing for clues in Quiapo, Severino asks a group of drunkards about Mokang, only to find shocking information about Tanggol.

videos.title: Surprise
videos.overview: As Annika's family surprises her with a fancy birthday gift, Santino realizes the huge difference in their social status. Lucio leads Mulong's group to Primo. David tries to bargain with Severino as the latter threatens to expose his true identity.

videos.title: First Kill
videos.overview: David sees red as he stops Severino from derailing Olga’s plans. A standoff ensues when Lucio confronts Primo during Yolly’s wake, only to be interrupted by the arrival of Augustus’ men. A dream reinforces Tanggol’s drive to avenge Mokang.

videos.title: Prison Week
videos.overview: Annika confesses her feelings for Santino. Don Julio orders Olga to find out anything about the name Severino uttered before his demise. Celso keeps his eyes peeled, believing that Bong will retaliate during their Prison Week celebration.

videos.title: Marcelo
videos.overview: Realizing that Marites will never learn if she keeps protecting her, Tindeng resolves to leave Rigor’s house with Noy. Amid the merrymaking in prison, two new convicts arrive at the correctional facility.

videos.title: Riot
videos.overview: After entering the Caballeros’ huge estate, Tindeng and Noy ask Bettina for a favor. Bong initiates his group’s deadly plan by attacking Dolores and her lackeys, creating a chain reaction that leads to a violent prison fight.

videos.title: Right Suspicion
videos.overview: Bubbles defends Tanggol as Rigor accuses him of starting the riot, unaware that her interference only confirms the police officer's suspicions about the anomalies in the prison. Olga warns David over Ramon's search for the man Severino last met.

videos.title: The New King
videos.overview: Olga fumes with rage upon learning that Edwin saw David the night Severino died. Tanggol’s cellmates cheer his name for finishing Bong off, unaware that his tenacity has attracted the attention of a very dangerous man

videos.title: Hatred of Revenge
videos.overview: Marites makes a veiled threat as Lena tries to refute Tindeng’s accusations against her and Rigor. Ramon meets up with General Rivas to make a pressing request. Marcelo introduces himself to Tanggol.

videos.title: Fugitive
videos.overview: Despite his friends’ dissuasion, Tanggol remains adamant about pushing through with his plan to escape from prison. David and Pablo clash during the Montenegros’ party. Olga seeks the aid of a powerful man upon getting wind of the prison riot.

videos.title: Drinking Session
videos.overview: Tanggol and Marcelo attempt to make a clean prison break. Determined to put a stop to the illegal operations at the penitentiary, Rigor begins confirming his suspicions about Bubbles.

videos.title: New Friend
videos.overview: Rigor and Mando discuss their next steps after gaining a new lead in their case build-up against Dolores. Edwin meets up with Marsing and Nita in secret. Drinking at a bar, Tanggol reveals to Marcelo his motivation for escaping from prison.

videos.title: Plan
videos.overview: Mando is filled with guilt after lying to Marites about Rigor and Lena’s affair. After encouraging Tanggol to make the necessary preparations before avenging Mokang, Marcelo urges the young man to follow his lead as the police arrive to arrest them.

videos.title: Recruit
videos.overview: Marites goes around Quiapo in hopes of finding Tindeng and Noy, only to spot a familiar face among a crowd of devotees. Needing fresh blood for his group, Marcelo promises to help Tanggol and his friends regain their freedom and start anew.

videos.title: Sympathy
videos.overview: Bettina lashes out at Tindeng upon learning that one of her figurines is damaged. Rigor and Mando secure a subpoena against Dolores. Tanggol finds out the reason why Bubbles does not entertain any suitors.

videos.title: Probity
videos.overview: Learning about the reason behind Tindeng’s departure, Olga urges Marites to tail Lena. Ramon and Don Facundo forge an alliance. Dolores asks Tanggol to keep his mouth shut as Rigor investigates the anomalies within the penitentiary.

videos.title: Hope
videos.overview: Bubbles excitedly announces her impending parole and swears to wait for Tanggol outside. Meanwhile, Tanggol and his friends get their hopes up with Marcelo's promise, unaware of the latter's cunning plan.

videos.title: Secret
videos.overview: Gary reprimands Santino upon learning that the promising boxer’s parents are unaware of his fights. David and Pablo go head-to-head in a shooting match. While Marcelo speaks of his plan to befriend Dolores, Bong’s cellmates approach Tanggol's group.

videos.title: Influence
videos.overview: Celso dissuades Tanggol and his friends from getting their hopes up, warning them against trusting Marcelo. Olga hides her rage as she poses as a good friend to Marites. The Montenegros receive bad news about one of their shipments in Quiapo.

videos.title: Manipulate
videos.overview: Olga makes up a somber story to encourage Rigor to fast-track his investigation into the anomalies within the NCF. Seeing Dolores’ distrust towards their new cellmate, Tanggol and his friends decide not to quickly pin their faith on Marcelo.

videos.title: Cap
videos.overview: As the Montenegros focus on regaining control over Quiapo, Olga looks forward to helping her daughter while plotting Dolores’ downfall. Tanggol and Bubbles make a promise to each other as the latter prepares to leave prison.

videos.title: Good News
videos.overview: Bubbles finally gets a taste of freedom. With Marcelo's help, Tanggol and his friends receive their court hearing schedule, much to Dolores' astonishment and Marites' delight.

videos.title: Motive
videos.overview: Olga watches from afar as Bubbles reunites with her family. Dolores grows concerned upon learning that Marcelo helped Tanggol and his friends get a competitive lawyer. Rigor gets wind of the reopening of his wayward son’s case.

videos.title: Confession
videos.overview: Ramon meets up with other syndicate bosses to express his desire to regain his family’s control over Quiapo. Berting gains valuable information about Severino. Tanggol and his friends arrive at the court for the reopening of their cases.

videos.title: Judgment
videos.overview: Lawrence comes up with a way to ruin Santino’s dream of becoming a boxing champion. Cross-examining Roda, Kap, and Rigor, Atty. Dela Cruz uses technicalities in a bid to weaken the cases against Tanggol and his friends.

videos.title: Debt
videos.overview: Kap and Mando warn Rigor that he might lose his job if his son decides to press charges against him. Celso urges Tanggol to keep his eyes peeled, believing that Marcelo will soon ask him to return the huge favor he received.

videos.title: Confused Feelings
videos.overview: While Rigor forbids his family from letting Tanggol back into the house, the latter feels emotional about his impending release without his friends by his side. David's attention is drawn to a lady at the bar, unaware of her connection to Pablo.

videos.title: Direction
videos.overview: Primo and Amanda announce their plan to turn a new leaf and leave for good. Bubbles lands a job at Jelly’s workplace. Marcelo brims with satisfaction as his plans come to fruition.

videos.title: Promise and Gratitude
videos.overview: Lucio helps Edwin and his gang escape from the police. Ahead of his nearing release, Tanggol expresses how much he loves his friends as he bids them farewell. Pablo lashes out at Tindeng as he accuses her of stealing his stuff.

videos.title: Friend
videos.overview: Lucio invites the Tondo gang to team up with him. Roused by a scuffling noise in the wee hours, Tindeng jumps into action upon seeing a person sneaking within the mansion. Tanggol worries about his future as he is set to leave his friends behind.

videos.title: Liberation
videos.overview: With Rigor and David at home, Marites cannot help but worry that Tanggol will directly return to their house as soon as he gets out of prison. Dolores gives Tanggol a warning before handing him his release order.

videos.title: Return to Quiapo
videos.overview: Tindeng serves her signature dish to Katherine as a peace offering following their inopportune first meeting. Coming straight from prison, Tanggol stops by Quiapo Church to pray for guidance, unaware of the trouble waiting for him at home.

videos.title: Kicked Out
videos.overview: After kicking out Tanggol, Rigor tells Marites that he will never allow their wayward son to return home. Pablo suspects that the person Katherine is texting is none other than Jesus.

videos.title: Tanggol's Fate
videos.overview: Olga holds back her surprise and the welling anger within her when she finds out from Marites that Tanggol has been released from prison. Bubbles brims with joy upon getting reunited with a dear friend.

videos.title: Beginning of a New Life
videos.overview: While Primo and Amanda prepare for their escape, Lucio gains new allies in Edwin and the Tondo Gang. Learning what Tanggol's family did to him, Bubbles offers her friend a place to stay and a shot at her work.

videos.title: Rent
videos.overview: Facundo comes up with a way to stop Bettina from picking on Tindeng. Bubbles and Jelly decide to help Tanggol find a job. Rigor and Mando acquire a solid piece of evidence against Dolores.

videos.title: Tondo and Binondo
videos.overview: Lucio and the Tondo Gang seize an opportunity to catch a big fish when the Red Phoenix group gets ambushed. Olga finally finds the person she is looking for as she visits Samantha.

videos.title: Protection
videos.overview: A group of unruly men harasses Bubbles at Baste’s bar. After getting saved by Lucio’s group, Angkong and Roy set their sights on making Tanggol pay. Primo and Amanda’s plan of starting over gets derailed when Augustus’ men arrive to apprehend them.
