videos.title: Promotion
videos.overview: Baste promotes Tanggol as his bar’s head bouncer despite learning that he is an ex-convict. Marites prepares food for Rigor, unaware that her husband is enjoying a meal with Lena. Marcelo and Dante recover Don Facundo’s drugs and money.

videos.title: Do Not Expect
videos.overview: Tanggol celebrates his promotion with his newfound friends, only to be reminded of his precious moments with Mokang. Unaware that her grandson is already out of prison, Tindeng turns to Don Facundo for help.

videos.title: Just Friends
videos.overview: Pablo burns with rage upon spotting Katherine with David. While Tanggol thinks of his friends in prison, Bubbles begins to consider letting go of her feelings for her new housemate.

videos.title: Beng
videos.overview: Marites is shaken to the core after discovering something while going through Rigor’s stuff. Olga vows to make Tanggol pay dearly if he endangers Samantha. Facundo grows impatient, wanting Marcelo’s new recruit to work for him as soon as possible.

videos.title: Visit
videos.overview: Rigor vows to put Tanggol back in jail as his investigation against Dolores bears fruit. Amid Facundo's doubt about Katherine dating David, Bettina sees this as an opportunity instead. Tanggol seeks Primo's help in looking for Mokang's husband.

videos.title: Fortune Teller
videos.overview: Ramon and Don Facundo meet to seal the deal on the laundering of the Montenegros’ wealth. Primo and Amanda resolve to avenge Mokang’s death to keep Tanggol away from trouble. Bubbles accompany Tanggol as he seeks advice from a fortuneteller.

videos.title: Thrift Shop
videos.overview: Santino participates in an inter-gym boxing tournament. Despite Facundo's permission, Pablo warns David to stay away from Katherine. Unaware that Marcelo has set foot in Quiapo to look for him, Tanggol goes to the market with Bubbles.

videos.title: Indebtedness
videos.overview: Lawrence divulges valuable information to the camp of Santino’s opponent ahead of the rookie’s bout. Olga pushes Marites to confirm her hunch about Rigor. Marcelo and Dante spot Tanggol and Bubbles in Quiapo.

videos.title: Confrontation
videos.overview: With Olga’s coaxing, Marites makes a scene after confirming Rigor and Lena’s affair with her very own eyes. Tanggol grows concerned as news of Dolores’ arrest hits the headlines.

videos.title: Heirs
videos.overview: Heeding Ramon’s advice, David meets up with Pablo in a bid to settle their differences. Obet informs Tanggol about his responsibilities as a bouncer. Returning home, Marites lashes out at Rigor for cheating on her.

videos.title: Stranger at the Billiards
videos.overview: Tanggol keeps his eyes peeled as Pablo and his armed men enter Baste’s bar. Santino finds a place where he and Marites can temporarily stay after their departure from Rigor’s house. Katherine asks Tindeng for advice regarding the man courting her.

videos.title: Billiards
videos.overview: Much to Tanggol's worry, Baste thinks of a cunning plan as he engages in a billiard match against Pablo. While Lena insists on staying at the Dimaguibas' residence, Marites regrets ignoring Tindeng's concerns in the past.

videos.title: Defeat
videos.overview: Chief Duran resorts to violence as he interrogates Celso about Dolores’ accomplices within the penitentiary. Worried that Tanggol might beat him in their high-stakes pool match, Pablo comes up with a way to unnerve his opponent.

videos.title: Defeat
videos.overview: Lena relocates to Rigor’s house. After losing the bet, Baste resolves to put his bar as collateral while finding a way to pay Pablo. Olga orders her men to unearth Mokang’s grave.

videos.title: Grave
videos.overview: After finally admitting the truth to his mother, Santino asks Marites to support his dream of becoming a boxing champion. Baste blames Tanggol for the precarious position he is in. Olga plans to use Mokang’s remains in her nefarious schemes.

videos.title: Ring
videos.overview: Marites’ world comes crashing down upon learning why Rigor decided to bring Lena to their house. Tanggol springs into action when a commotion breaks out in front of Betchay’s food stall.

videos.title: Visitor
videos.overview: Despite Tanggol's warning, Bubbles decides to go out with Pablo. Katherine turns to Tindeng for advice when Bettina forces her to be hasty with David. Beng encourages Marites to fight for her place in Rigor's heart.

videos.title: Fetch
videos.overview: Lena makes up a reason as she tenders her resignation to Col. Suarez. Roda, Marsing, and Nita get wind of Rigor’s affair. Bubbles refuses Tanggol’s offer to accompany her during her date with Pablo.

videos.title: Visit
videos.overview: Rigor and Lena deny the rumors about their affair as news of the latter’s resignation reaches their colleagues. Marites decides to hide the problems plaguing their family as Tanggol pays him a visit at her stall.

videos.title: Date
videos.overview: Pablo brings Bubbles to a fine dining restaurant. Marcelo urges Facundo to be wary of the Montenegros. Tanggol escorts Frida to Betchay’s house upon learning that the eatery owner got robbed and beaten up.

videos.title: Recover
videos.overview: Marcelo sees Don Facundo’s alliance with the Montenegros as an opportunity for him to get back at Don Julio. David fails to seal a deal with one of Montenegros’ clients. Tanggol listens intently as Bubbles talks to Jelly about her date with Pablo.

videos.title: One Against Two
videos.overview: As the bar employees worry for their jobs, Obet thinks of how Baste can reclaim Big B's from Pablo. Due to their malicious remarks, Rigor gets into a brawl with Luis and Mario.

videos.title: Take Home
videos.overview: Santino fails to rein in all his pent-up anger as he trains at the gym. Baste bets his last bargaining chip as he invites Pablo to play another game of high-stakes pool. Rigor admits to Mando the real reason behind Lena’s resignation.

videos.title: Rematch
videos.overview: Edwin informs Lucio and the Tondo gang that Tanggol has already regained his freedom. Tanggol prays for guidance as he is forced to make a tricky shot in his rematch against Pablo.

videos.title: Return
videos.overview: Roy sends the Montenegros a message after attacking one of their warehouses. Tanggol and Bubbles celebrate with Baste and their co-workers after winning their bet against Pablo. David admits to Rigor that he is not happy with Camille anymore.

videos.title: Cook Off
videos.overview: Bubbles brims with joy upon noticing that Tanggol is showing hints of jealousy. Lena finds a way to prove that she is better than Marites. Ramon burns with rage after learning that the Red Phoenix took all their drugs from their fallen warehouse.

videos.title: Treated
videos.overview: Tension heats up at the Dimaguiba residence when Rigor decides to split his income between Marites and Lena. Heeding Bubbles' advice, Tanggol heads out to visit his mother.

videos.title: Sharing
videos.overview: Bettina orders her maids to keep themselves out of sight after learning that Katherine’s suitor is arriving at their mansion. Tanggol treats Marites to a meal, intending to confirm the information he got from Beng.

videos.title: Tears for Mother
videos.overview: Noy and Tindeng try to sneak a look at the face of Katherine’s suitor. Angkong and Roy plan to attack Amanda next. Tanggol fumes as Marites opens up about Rigor’s infidelity.

videos.title: The Child Rushes
videos.overview: Despite Marites’ pleas, Tanggol heads to his family’s home to confront Rigor. The Red Phoenix meets up with a buyer, unaware of the trap they are stepping into. Wanting to get even, Luis and Mario vow to teach Rigor a valuable lesson.

videos.title: Hospital
videos.overview: Frida teases Bubbles about her true feelings for Tanggol. Despite the upcoming arrival of officials from the NCF, Rigor rushes to the hospital after learning about what happened to Lena.

videos.title: Ally
videos.overview: Marites vows to stop Lena from destroying her family further after Rigor's mistress painted Tanggol in a bad light. Bubbles comforts Tanggol as misery and sorrow fill her friend's heart.

videos.title: Bought World
videos.overview: Rigor turns a deaf ear when Camille reveals that Tanggol did not push Lena down the stairs. Annika musters all her courage as she confesses her feelings for Santino. Pablo uses his wealth to get closer to Bubbles.

videos.title: Condition
videos.overview: Facundo and Bettina argue over Jesus’ move to court Katherine. Mando lends an ear to Marites’ troubles as the fraught woman drowns her tears in booze. Bubbles resolves to accept Pablo’s request in a bid to prevent Tanggol from getting fired.

videos.title: New Boss
videos.overview: Following a profound conversation about bravery, Facundo allows Tindeng to get close with Katherine. Baste announces to his staff that Pablo is the new owner of the bar. Lucio comes up with a plan against the Montenegros.

videos.title: Felt
videos.overview: Tanggol and Bubbles get into an argument as the former expresses his concern over the latter’s move to make a deal with Pablo. Soon, the two clear the air between them, only to be teased by an eavesdropping Frida.

videos.title: Alberto
videos.overview: Bettina looks forward to meeting Pablo's girlfriend and excitedly prepares for her arrival. An argument erupts between Bubbles and Tanggol when the latter learns about Alberto's whereabouts.

videos.title: Concern
videos.overview: Marites tries to make Santino understand her reason for sticking with Rigor. Tindeng begins to see Facundo in a different light as her boss accompanies her to the market. Pablo reveals his plan to introduce Bubbles to his grandmother.

videos.title: Planning
videos.overview: Col. Suarez reprimands Rigor for failing to entertain the NCF officials. Pablo introduces Bubbles to Bettina as his girlfriend. Primo’s group urges Tanggol to cautiously assess Alberto’s forces first before making a move.

videos.title: Snare
videos.overview: Ramon agrees to meet up with Mr. Tolentino to resume their transaction, unaware that he is about to step into the Red Phoenix’s trap. Olga brims with delight as her plan to make Ramon and Tanggol meet comes to fruition.

videos.title: Three Groups
videos.overview: Pablo tries to force himself on Bubbles, only to be stopped by Tindeng. Despite Primo and Amanda’s warnings, Tanggol throws caution to the wind and infiltrates Ramon’s facility, oblivious to the Red Phoenix's presence in the area.

videos.title: Face Off
videos.overview: Tindeng helps Bubbles escape after Pablo tried to take advantage of the young lady again. While Tanggol finally comes face-to-face with Alberto, Lucio finds an opportunity to exact his revenge on Primo.

videos.title: After the Battle
videos.overview: Ramon informs Don Julio about the man who tried to kill him, recalling his apprehension to finish off his assailant. Edwin sneaks into his family’s home to meet up with Marsing and Nita. Berting blames Tanggol for the costly failure of their mission.

videos.title: Second Thoughts
videos.overview: Ramon fails to get over the fact that he hesitated to kill someone for the first time, admitting that he saw himself in the man who attacked him. Tanggol is roused from his dark thoughts after hearing about what Pablo did to Bubbles.

videos.title: Real Enemy
videos.overview: Roy lashes out at Lucio for celebrating despite the failure of his group to accomplish their mission. Seeing red after hearing Pablo insult Bubbles, Tanggol makes the arrogant man taste his burning wrath.

videos.title: Inspiration
videos.overview: The Caballeros are shocked to the core upon seeing Pablo’s black and blue face. Wanting to get back at Rigor, Luis and Mario open fire on the Dimaguibas’ house. Tanggol admits to Bubbles that she is one of his inspirations to change for the better.

videos.title: Ally
videos.overview: Poisoned by Lena's lies, David lashes out at Camille for taking Tanggol's side. While Pablo plots his revenge, Tanggol comes clean to Bubbles about his encounter with Alberto. Meanwhile, Tindeng starts to miss her family.

videos.title: Birthday
videos.overview: Marites’ decision to let Roda stay in their house sparks a heated argument among the Dimaguibas. Bubbles heads to Quiapo Church with Tanggol to celebrate her birthday, unaware of the trouble tailing her.

videos.title: Birthday Prayer
videos.overview: Ramon meets up with General Rivas in hopes of learning about the identity of the man who attacked him. Pablo and his men lurk outside the Quiapo Church as Tanggol and Bubbles pray for their families and friends.

videos.title: Quiapo Boxer
videos.overview: Augustus informs Rigor and Mando that they are up for promotion. Ramon comes up with a way to find out the identity of the man who took Monique. Visiting Kamao Gym, Tanggol gets to meet Santino’s coaches and love interest.

videos.title: Brother's Support
videos.overview: A shootout ensues when Edwin and the Tondo gang spot Ramon’s men while selling drugs in Quiapo. Tisoy resorts to a dirty tactic to avoid getting beaten by Santino in the ring, prompting Tanggol to step in and defend his brother.

videos.title: Abducted
videos.overview: Heeding Bettina's request, Facundo hesitantly arranges a meeting with the Montenegros. Tanggol brims with excitement as he buys presents for Bubbles, unaware of Pablo's wicked plan.

videos.title: Return to Quiapo
videos.overview: Lucio convinces Angkong to accept Marsing and Nita into their fold. Tanggol returns to Quiapo upon learning that Bubbles has not returned home after they split up. Katherine comes up with a way to help Tindeng visit her family.

videos.title: Search
videos.overview: Following Angkong’s orders, Lucio and his group ambush Augustus and Col. Suarez’s convoy. While looking for Bubbles, Tanggol helps a woman retrieve her bag from a snatcher. Tindeng receives both good and bad news while visiting Marites’ market stall.

videos.title: Guns and Weapons
videos.overview: All hell breaks loose when Tindeng sees Lena living with the Dimaguibas. Pablo stops at nothing to exact his revenge as an assaulted Bubbles finally returns to Tanggol and her family.

videos.title: Hide
videos.overview: While using Katherine’s phone to set a date with Jesus, Bettina finds out that her granddaughter went to Quiapo with Tindeng. Tanggol boils with cold rage as Bubbles aches from Pablo’s vile transgression.

videos.title: Repentance
videos.overview: Augustus accepts the Red Phoenix's demands but under one condition. While Primo pays no heed to Berting and Amanda's pleas, a guilt-ridden Tanggol promises to avenge Bubbles.

videos.title: Crushed
videos.overview: Augustus resolves to use the Red Phoenix in his plans. Tisoy and his friends gang up on Santino, leaving the aspiring boxer with an injured hand. Tanggol storms out after speaking with a troubled Bubbles.

videos.title: Spy
videos.overview: Rigor informs his family about his upcoming promotion. Ramon learns that Facundo made a deal with his drug supplier. Determined to avenge Bubbles, Tanggol heads to the casino owned by the Caballeros as he tracks down Pablo.

videos.title: Hammer
videos.overview: Roda helps Marites prepare for Rigor’s pinning ceremony. Sneaking into the Caballeros’ casino, Tanggol improvises as he prepares to ambush Pablo and his men. Tindeng searches for Noy’s phone in a bid to contact her daughter.

videos.title: Run Over
videos.overview: News of Pablo’s demise reaches the Caballeros. Marcelo convinces Tanggol to join his group. David boils with rage after spotting a familiar yet unwelcome face while heading to Rigor’s ceremony.

videos.title: Promotion
videos.overview: Marsing comes up with an ingenious plan of selling Red Phoenix's drugs. Lena attends Rigor's pinning ceremony unannounced. As he decides his fate, Tanggol tries to convince Primo to join Marcelo's group.

videos.title: Persuasion
videos.overview: Primo informs Amanda about his decision regarding Tanggol’s offer. Lena faints during Rigor’s pinning ceremony. Emong heads home to retrieve some clothes, only to be spotted by Olga’s men.

videos.title: Riddle
videos.overview: Bubbles grabs a knife and storms out of Jelly’s house upon learning about the men tailing Emong. The feast David prepared for Rigor gets spoiled when Lena lashes out at the newly promoted police officer for always putting Marites first.

videos.title: Fair
videos.overview: Don Julio plans to condole with the Caballeros upon getting wind of Pablo’s death. Realizing his mistakes, Rigor attempts to rekindle the waning love between him and Marites. Tanggol vows to put his life on the line just to protect Bubbles.

videos.title: Confession
videos.overview: Marites confides in Mando about her marital problems, admitting that she is struggling to fight for her marriage. Olga fumes as she fails to reach Diego and Paquito. Bubbles asks Tanggol if he has feelings for her.

videos.title: Job
videos.overview: Lena refuses to back down and give up Rigor upon learning that he apologized to Marites. Jelly advises Tanggol and Bubbles to seek a new job to avoid suspicion regarding Pablo's death.

videos.title: Job Hunting
videos.overview: The Caballeros mourn Pablo’s untimely passing. Olga lashes out at David for still spending time with the Dimaguibas, urging the fake Montenegro heir to choose a side. Bubbles catches the attention of a talent scout while applying for a job.

videos.title: Madonna
videos.overview: Rigor and Mando begin to investigate Pablo’s murder. Marites and Roda grow curious about Marsing and Nita’s booming business. A masked assailant initiates a deadly fight with Tanggol.

videos.title: Wake
videos.overview: As David tries to comfort Kaherine, Rigor and Mando arrive at Pablo’s wake. Noy spots Beng among the Caballeros' high-profile guests. Tanggol draws out his gun upon seeing a familiar face at Marcelo’s hideout.

videos.title: First Meeting
videos.overview: Marites and Roda grow suspicious of Marsing and Nita’s shady customers. Tindeng sees red upon seeing Rigor at Pablo’s wake. Marcelo introduces Tanggol to Facundo.

videos.title: Gunpoint
videos.overview: Roda's nosiness leads to Edwin's arrest. David flies into a rage upon seeing Tanggol talking to Katherine. As she finally finds her daughter, Beng tries to convince Bubbles to stay away from Ramon's real heir.

videos.title: Report
videos.overview: Roda informs Marites that Edwin got arrested. David bumps into Rigor, notifying his father that he met Tanggol at the Caballeros’ estate. Olga and Bubbles’ eyes well with tears as they talk about the missing people in their lives.

videos.title: Doubt
videos.overview: David asks Katherine about her relationship with the man she was speaking with. After escaping from the police, Primo is left with no choice but to show his fighting skills after getting into an argument with Marcelo.

videos.title: Escape
videos.overview: Tanggol’s friends in prison are sent to an isolation cell after getting into trouble. David learns that Tanggol is acquainted with the woman involved in Pablo’s case. Marites explains to Lena why she is no longer concerned with Rigor’s whereabouts.

videos.title: Free
videos.overview: After learning about Don Julio’s future plans, Olga vows to make Bubbles inherit everything that she never received as an adopted Montenegro. Tanggol and his allies exchange fire with jail guards as they provide cover for the escaping prisoners.

videos.title: Bridge
videos.overview: Olga is forced to admit the truth to Bubbles when her oblivious daughter refuses to leave. An intense police chase erupts, pushing Tanggol to make a daring move to escape.

videos.title: Cemetery
videos.overview: Devastated by the news of Bubbles’ tragic fate, Celso pleads with Tanggol to let him see his family. Meanwhile, David and his men gear up after confirming that the woman they spotted is Samantha.

videos.title: Farewell
videos.overview: Augustus issues a shoot-to-kill order against Tanggol’s friends. Blood spills as Tanggol and Celso chase after David's forces, hell-bent on avenging Bubbles.

videos.title: Wake
videos.overview: Marites is compelled to accept Marsing’s unfair offer to save Rigor’s life. Upon learning of Celso’s escape, Olga rushes to Samantha’s location, unaware of the tragedy that has befallen her daughter.

videos.title: Separation
videos.overview: Ramon and Facundo get into a heated argument while their families meet to arrange Jesus and Katherine’s wedding. Fearing that Tanggol will endanger them, Amanda decides to leave Marcelo’s group and return to their hideout.

videos.title: Retraction
videos.overview: Aware that they cannot take on their enemies alone, Primo hopes to convince Amanda to join forces with Tanggol again. While Tanggol pays his last respects to Bubbles, Olga suddenly arrives to reclaim her daughter's remains.

videos.title: Choose
videos.overview: A standoff erupts when Tanggol and his friends return to Marcelo’s hideout. Following Noy’s advice, Tindeng sneaks out of the Caballero estate to file a complaint against Rigor and confront Lena.

videos.title: Lure
videos.overview: Marcelo briefs Tanggol and his allies on their first mission under Facundo. Angkong devises a plan to become Quiapo’s leading drug supplier. After an emotional reunion with Tindeng, Marites receives a call from a distraught Beng.

videos.title: Face Off
videos.overview: Tanggol’s group heads to their first mission, unaware of the trap they are stepping into. While escaping from her abductors, Marites recalls a traumatic experience after bumping into a fleeing man.

videos.title: Tanggol's Parents
videos.overview: Don Julio orders Bullet and his men to scour Manila and find Ramon after learning that his son got ambushed by unknown assailants. Marcelo mobilizes Tanggol’s group after Facundo’s successful deal with a criminal mafia.

videos.title: Bitterness of the Past
videos.overview: David brims with joy as he strongly believes that Don Julio's heir is already dead. After saving Ramon's life, Marites confronts the ghost from her past for what he did to her.

videos.title: Star of Venus
videos.overview: Ramon returns home, spoiling David’s celebration. While escaping from the police, Madonna gets shot and drops the precious gems in her possession, giving Tanggol a chance to get close to them.

videos.title: Going Home
videos.overview: Mando informs Marites that the one who shot Rigor is none other than Tanggol, reinforcing her belief that her son has turned to the dark side. Don Facundo discovers that the Star of Venus is missing.

videos.title: Paid
videos.overview: Don Facundo instructs Marcelo to keep an eye on Tanggol, suspecting that the ex-convict may have stolen the Star of Venus. Bettina fires Tindeng for leaving without permission. Tanggol’s group receives their cut after completing their first mission.

videos.title: Planning
videos.overview: Believing that Lucio’s group has killed Ramon, Angkong sets his sights on getting back at Tanggol and his allies. Ramon considers making amends with the woman who saved his life. Rigor suspects that Marites is hiding something from him.

videos.title: Gambling
videos.overview: Ramon considers inviting Marites to David's wedding as he grows determined to make it up to her. Recovering the Star of Venus, Tanggol and his friends waste no time to profit from it.

videos.title: Poker
videos.overview: Ramon asks Olga about Jesus’ mother. Using the complaint Tindeng filed, Augustus and Col. Suarez assess whether they can coerce Rigor into doing their bidding. Tanggol rigs a deck of cards before entering the casino.

videos.title: Bet
videos.overview: Edwin informs Marsing and Nita that his group has killed Mokang’s husband. While cleaning their room, Camille discovers David’s wedding. As the Star of Venus raises the stakes, a woman joins Tanggol’s table.

videos.title: Oppose
videos.overview: Ramon loses his cool when Facundo delivers gems and drugs instead of the money they had agreed upon. Following the address on the wedding invitation she found, Camille heads to the church where David is set to marry another woman.

videos.title: New Business
videos.overview: Camille collapses after her failed attempt to stop the wedding. Raul’s boss offers Tanggol and his friends a lucrative deal in exchange for the Star of Venus.

videos.title: Camille
videos.overview: To celebrate the start of their success, Tanggol and his friends go to a bar, where they encounter a familiar face. David seizes an opportunity to eliminate Camille once and for all.

videos.title: Lucio's Raid
videos.overview: Marites and Santino learn of Camille’s untimely passing. Concluding that Tanggol’s group possesses the Star of Venus, Lucio devises a plan to accomplish his new mission while avenging Yolly’s death.

videos.title: Hideout
videos.overview: Marites delivers the news of Camille’s passing to her family. Olga learns of Ramon’s intention to find Marites. Primo’s group is forced to flee from Lucio’s gang and the Red Phoenix, prompting Tanggol to lead his allies to his friend’s hideout.

videos.title: Wealth
videos.overview: Facundo informs Marcelo that the Montenegros are now their enemies. Despite despising how Roy treats him, Lucio refuses to break away from the Red Phoenix. Divina offers to let Tanggol and his friends stay at one of her properties.

videos.title: New Clothes
videos.overview: Rigor vows to uncover the truth behind Camille’s untimely passing. Olga plans to eliminate Marites before Ramon’s men track the woman down. Divina explains to her men why she wants to help Tanggol despite his troubling past.

videos.title: Suspicion
videos.overview: As David returns to the Montenegro mansion with Katherine, Olga tells him that Ramon is trying to reconnect with Marites. While Amanda warns Tanggol about Divina, the latter informs the group about her business plans.

videos.title: Divina's Island
videos.overview: Ramon asks Katherine if she knows what kind of person her grandfather really is. Primo's group remains on the fence about trusting Divina. Facundo decides to accompany Tindeng to Quiapo.

videos.title: Gold
videos.overview: Divina informs Tanggol how they will earn huge sums of money using both fake and real gold bars. David tries to stop Ramon from re-entering his mother’s life. After going around Quiapo with Facundo, Tindeng pays Marites a visit.

videos.title: Ambition
videos.overview: While his friends have fun, Tanggol tours Divina's vast property by helicopter. Ramon receives shocking news from one of his informants in Quiapo. Facundo comforts Tindeng as Marites fights for her life after being stabbed.

videos.title: Convinced
videos.overview: While fencing the drugs they stole from the Montenegros’ coffers, the Tondo gang runs into Bullet and his men in Quiapo. Tanggol’s kindness helps Divina convince the island’s local community to work for them.

videos.title: Ward
videos.overview: While the locals positively consider Divina's offer, Amanda starts to feel guilty for deceiving them. Unaware that Marites has regained consciousness, Olga vows to kill the rest of Tanggol's family.

videos.title: Recovering
videos.overview: Primo, Amanda, and Berting voice their concerns about Divina’s plan to use the island's locals. Rigor rushes to the hospital after hearing about what happened to Marites, unaware that Ramon is nearby.

videos.title: Glimmer of Wealth
videos.overview: Bettina notices the clothes Facundo bought in Quiapo. As a display of power, Roy returns Teban and Kidlat to Lucio. Amanda warns Tanggol about the dangers of being blinded by someone's wealth.

videos.title: Gunpoint
videos.overview: After trying to convince Amanda that she would not betray them, Divina advises Tanggol to reconsider his alliance with Facundo. Ramon visits Marites but is forced to flee upon seeing Rigor.

videos.title: Percent
videos.overview: Rigor confronts Marites about what she is hiding from him, revealing that he caught a glimpse of Ramon at the hospital. Tanggol accepts Don Facundo’s offer with one condition.

videos.title: Accused
videos.overview: Ramon hunts down Marites's assailant. Rigor discovers Santino's secret after his youngest son gets dragged into a murder case. Don Facundo and Tanggol begin their illegal drug operations.

videos.title: Quadrant
videos.overview: Burning with jealousy, Bettina locks Tindeng and Noy in the stable. Rigor takes Santino to the police station. Marcelo orders Madonna to keep a close watch on Tanggol as the Star of Venus remains missing.

videos.title: Fair
videos.overview: Tanggol informs his friends that Facundo's men remain suspicious of him. Despite her injuries, Marites kneels and pleads with Rigor to release Santino. Divina finds a buyer for the Star of Venus.

videos.title: Leaving Behind
videos.overview: Olga hunts for Ramon’s informant in Quiapo. Annika helps prove Santino’s innocence. Divina devises a plan to stop the potential buyer of the Star of Venus from setting them up.

videos.title: Exchange
videos.overview: Edwin spots Santino while dealing drugs in Quiapo. Ramon lashes out at David for failing to gather information about Facundo's plans. Mr. Geronimo tries to stall when Divina and Tanggol arrive to finalize their deal ahead of schedule.

videos.title: Ambiguous
videos.overview: David finds himself torn between the conflict of the Montenegros and the Caballeros, until Ramon confirms his suspicion. Tanggol and Divina's transaction with Mr. Geronimo turns awry.

videos.title: There is Hope
videos.overview: Divina loses her temper when Amanda questions her competence after the failed transaction with Mr. Geronimo. Facundo offers Tindeng and Noy a temporary place to stay after they leave the Caballero estate.

videos.title: Surprise
videos.overview: A deadly gunfight erupts when Marcelo shows up to meet Mr. Villegas instead of Don Facundo, thwarting Ramon’s plan to eliminate his former business partner. Amid the chaos, Marcelo and Olga reunite, reopening old wounds.

videos.title: Wounded Don
videos.overview: Ramon informs Olga of his plan to strike the Caballeros once Don Julio recovers. David discovers that Tanggol is working for Don Facundo. A pressing issue forces Apo Manuel to reconsider and accept Divina's offer.

videos.title: Sinful Gold
videos.overview: After regaining consciousness, Don Julio blames Olga for his misfortune. Apo Manuel, Ato, and Ima arrive at Divina's estate to accept her offer, leading Primo to urge Tanggol to tell their workers the truth about the gold bars they are about to sell.

videos.title: Real Gold
videos.overview: Roda willingly cooperates with the police investigating Rigor. Marites tells Ramon that his enemies might be behind the attack on her. Tanggol's group thinks of a clever way to help Apo Manuel, Ato, and Ima sell the fake gold bars.

videos.title: Portrait
videos.overview: Tanggol's group is forced to step in when the gold deal takes a dangerous turn. Facundo struggles to control his emotions as he says goodbye to Tindeng. Investigators uncover a new lead regarding Pablo's killer.

videos.title: Covered Up
videos.overview: Rigor lies through his teeth as his honor and integrity as a police officer are called into question by internal affairs. Facundo finally identifies the man responsible for Pablo's death.

videos.title: Caballero's Revenge
videos.overview: Primo's group delivers the money to Divina. Marcelo asks about Bubbles' death just as Tanggol and his friends walk into Don Facundo's trap. Getting wind of the Montenegros' plan against her family, Katherine attempts to escape.

videos.title: Escape
videos.overview: Ramon is forced to launch a preemptive strike against the Caballeros after discovering Katherine’s escape. Marcelo is enraged as Don Facundo questions Tanggol about his motive for killing Pablo.

videos.title: Run Out of Race
videos.overview: Don Facundo hurries to rescue Bettina and Katherine after learning about the Montenegros' attack, leaving Madonna to determine the fate of Tanggol and his friends. Meanwhile, Marcelo seizes the chaos as a chance to escape.

videos.title: Annihilation
videos.overview: The Montenegros unleash their wrath, making the Caballeros pay for betraying their trust. Marcelo makes a chilling vow when he comes face to face with Ramon. Tanggol finds blood everywhere as he and his friends make their escape.

videos.title: The Heir
videos.overview: Tanggol and his friends return to their lair. An unsuspecting Santino falls for Lawrence's lies while Rigor prepares to arrest Coach Gary's real killer. David makes a move to acquire the Caballeros' wealth.

videos.title: Fist Against Fist
videos.overview: Edwin and the Tondo gang find a new place to sell their goods. Unaware of the danger he is in, Santino goes head-to-head against Tisoy in a bloody match.

videos.title: Confession
videos.overview: Santino is put in a precarious position when the police raid the underground fighting den to arrest Lawrence. Olga fumes after realizing Ramon robbed her of the chance to finish off Marcelo. Tanggol leaves Madonna stunned with a startling admission.

videos.title: Boarder
videos.overview: Marsing devises a plan to keep neighbors from questioning their sudden wealth. Divina and Amanda clash over what happened to Tanggol's group. Marites confronts Rigor for prioritizing his honor as a cop over his responsibilities as a father.

videos.title: Kicked Out
videos.overview: Tensions in the Dimaguiba household reach a breaking point, leading Rigor to finally kick Lena out. Tanggol's group plots to seize control of Facundo's drug lab after the Caballeros' massacre. Divina uncovers unsettling details about Amanda's past.

videos.title: Move Over
videos.overview: An opportunity to stay close to Rigor falls into Lena's lap. Tension erupts between Tanggol and Primo's group over Divina's demand in their drug business plans.

videos.title: Separated
videos.overview: Supremo and Amanda ultimately decide to sever their ties with Tanggol. Angkong turns to an ally for help upon learning about the Montenegros' attack on the Caballeros.

videos.title: Inheritance
videos.overview: David receives bad news during his meeting with the new lawyer tasked with managing the Caballeros' wealth after their untimely death. Meanwhile, reassured by Madonna that no one knows of Don Facundo's hideout, Tanggol decides to take it over.

videos.title: Forgiveness
videos.overview: Marites brims with happiness when a woman buys all her merchandise, unaware that it is part of Ramon’s plan to get close to her. Refusing to sell drugs in Quiapo, Tanggol comes up with another way to earn large sums of money.

videos.title: Unlucky or Fortunate
videos.overview: David loses all the money he earned during a high-stakes poker game. Tanggol's group spots Col. Suarez while searching for a table at a gambling den. Dining at a fancy restaurant, Ramon asks Marites for her forgiveness.

videos.title: Blame
videos.overview: Tanggol tries to obtain the gambling den in a match, with the Star of Venus as his wager. Tension erupts in the Dimaguiba household anew when Rigor confronts Roda for reporting him to NLEA.

videos.title: Lifting and Dispersal
videos.overview: Tanggol learns that Colonel Suarez is still looking for the Star of Venus. David's defiance prompts Olga to scheme against the fake Montenegro heir. Santino turns to Edwin for a job, only to get a horrible one from Lucio.

videos.title: Celebration
videos.overview: Lucio gives Santino another chance despite his failure to prove himself to the group. Primo devises a new plan as he and his group aim to start a new life. Tanggol remains determined to share his success with the residents of Quiapo.

videos.title: Boss Tanggol
videos.overview: Marsing and Nita agree they need to get on Lena’s good side, unaware that the former police officer has already discovered their secret. As her assets snowball, Divina reaches a decision regarding the leadership of her growing group with Tanggol.

videos.title: Return to Quiapo
videos.overview: Tanggol defends Madonna as his friends question her trustworthiness. The Montenegros scramble to protect their monopoly in Quiapo as a new drug emerges, while David sleeps off a night of revelry.

videos.title: Reunion
videos.overview: Santino reluctantly agrees to join the Tondo gang in selling drugs. Ramon gives David a task as punishment, leading to an intense altercation between the latter and Olga. Tanggol's group returns to Quiapo to share their blessings.

videos.title: On the Job
videos.overview: Tanggol excitedly heads home to visit Marites. David agrees to meet with Vera to discuss the Caballeros' wealth. Unable to stomach the ways of the Tondo gang, Santino walks out on them but soon gets caught in a precarious situation.

videos.title: Interpretation
videos.overview: Tanggol heads home expecting a warm welcome from his family, only to be rendered speechless when Marites questions him about the night Rigor got shot while responding to a prison break.

videos.title: Carnappers
videos.overview: The Tondo gang debates Santino's value to their group after a police run-in. David asks Atty. Vera out on a date. Tisay and her crew plan to steal luxury cars from a gambling den in Quiapo.

videos.title: Tisay
videos.overview: While gambling at an exclusive gaming house, David picks up useful intel on Atty. Vera. Roda notices Marites seems troubled after her son’s visit. Tanggol sees red when he spots Tisay playing at one of his tables.

videos.title: Outsmarted
videos.overview: Madonna and Divina comfort a disheartened Tanggol following his unpleasant encounter with his mother. Ramon tries to sway Marites' mind about their son when his request gets rejected.

videos.title: Wasting
videos.overview: Tanggol and his friends head to the bar where Tisay works, hoping to settle the score with her. The Montenegros finally identify the source of the Red Chaser, while David indulges in gambling.

videos.title: Hostage
videos.overview: Tanggol uncovers new leads on Tisay. Ramon fails to rein in his anger as David attempts to justify his wayward actions. Augustus orders Col. Suarez to deploy all available forces after hearing of a nearby burglary.

videos.title: Rejection
videos.overview: Tanggol devises a clever plan to track down the cars Tisay has stolen. Rigor openly criticizes their actions during the hostage incident, embarrassing both Augustus and Col. Suarez. A delivery triggers yet another argument in the Dimaguiba household.

videos.title: Sworn
videos.overview: Drunk and upset, Lena lashes out at Nita and Marsing, then confronts Marites at the Dimaguiba house. The chairman steps in, but Lena stirs chaos at the precinct by revealing her and Rigor's secret. Tanggol and his group set a trap for Tisay.

videos.title: Deep Wounds
videos.overview: Tanggol dispels Madonna's worries and plans for his next move against Tisay. Lucio and the Tondo gang set their sights on a new target. Meanwhile, Lena vows vengeance against everyone who wronged her.

videos.title: Placed
videos.overview: Tanggol and his cohorts set their plan against Tisay in motion. At the precinct, Rigor finds himself in hot water after Colonel Suarez chided him about Lena's revelations.

videos.title: Welcome
videos.overview: Tanggol’s group sets a trap for Tisay’s crew, but Col. Suarez’s sudden arrival forces the thieves to flee. David pressures Atty. Vera to speed up the Caballeros' wealth transfer. Marites considers helping Lena, who ends up in an accident.

videos.title: Innocent
videos.overview: David seeks Olga's help to carry out Ramon’s order to eliminate the Red Phoenix. Tanggol prepares to lure Tisay into his trap. Rigor is consumed with rage after discovering that Lena has lost their unborn child.

videos.title: Trap to Trap
videos.overview: Tanggol charms Tisay into a date while she secretly plots her next carjacking heist. The Tondo Gang sows doubt in Santino about Tanggol's true nature. Noy faces a personal health scare but keeps it hidden from Tindeng.

videos.title: Rush
videos.overview: A rift grows between the Tondo Gang and the Red Phoenix following Lucio's unannounced visit to the drug lab. Amid their clash, Olga and David arrive to destroy them.

videos.title: Sympathy
videos.overview: Tanggol continues to seduce Tisay by showing off his collection of luxury sports cars. While David badmouths Marites to Rigor, Lena's sanity slowly slips away.

videos.title: A Trap
videos.overview: In an abandoned house, a vengeful Lena spirals into madness over the loss of her child. Olga overhears Ramon talking to Marites over the phone. Tanggol ups his efforts to lure Tisay into his trap, with his friends closely monitoring their moves.

videos.title: Intense Chase
videos.overview: After Mr. Wu accepts Lucio's group into the Red Chaser business, Santino is consumed by worry and guilt as he recalls his first kill. Tanggol's group charges into action, closing the gap in a heart-pounding chase after Tisay and her team.

videos.title: Revenge
videos.overview: The intense chase reaches a bloody climax as Tanggol and his group storm Tisay's garage. Marites grows emotional upon Ramon's arrival, oblivious to a pair of vengeful eyes silently watching their every move.

videos.title: Rescue
videos.overview: Ramon and Marites share a tender moment until Olga launches an attack against them. Tanggol makes a bold statement despite feeling a pang of regret over Tisay's tragic fate.

videos.title: Kiss
videos.overview: Tanggol advises his group to keep their guard up now that their business is thriving. A tense argument erupts between Don Julio and Olga, while Marites starts to see Ramon in a new light.

videos.title: Abandoned Treasures
videos.overview: Beginning to recognize her worth, Marites stands her ground when Rigor blames her for the consequences of his actions. Ramon reflects on his feelings for the mother of his child. Tanggol asks Madonna about Don Facundo's businesses and properties.

videos.title: Noy
videos.overview: Tanggol plans to claim the Caballeros' wealth through their last living relative, unaware that David is plotting his own move. Driven by desperation, Noy commits a crime. Lena launches her unhinged plan to destroy the Dimaguibas.

videos.title: First Victim
videos.overview: Alerted by Divina to a major issue in their drug business, Tanggol devises a clever strategy to attract new clients. A weakened Noy tries to hide as Lena closes in on him.

videos.title: Frenny
videos.overview: Tanggol's group considers getting a protector as their goods receive growing interest. Tindeng and Marites' search for Noy ends in tragedy. Elsewhere, Lena sets her sights on her next target.

videos.title: Checkpoint
videos.overview: Rigor learns about Lena's attack on Roda. Augustus orders Red Phoenix to locate Primo. To their shock, Tanggol and his group encounter a police checkpoint while on their way to a drug transaction.

videos.title: Knock
videos.overview: Despite Divina's warning, Tanggol risks everything to save his friends. Out of anger, Edwin reveals to Santino why Lucio and the Tondo gang took him in. Marites and Tindeng grow worried after hearing troubling news about Roda.

videos.title: Lena
videos.overview: After evading the police, Tanggol confronts Divina for abandoning their allies. Chaos erupts when Lena storms into the Dimaguiba household, determined to make Marites and Tindeng pay.

videos.title: Poison
videos.overview: Tanggol leverages the Star of Venus as a bargaining chip after Col. Suarez clears out his gambling den’s coffers with uncanny luck. Consumed by fury, Olga sets her deadly plan in motion to wipe out the entire Montenegro family.

videos.title: Winning
videos.overview: Olga feigns innocence when confronted about Don Julio's poisoning. Rigor grows deeply worried for Marites. With a lot at stake, Tanggol and Colonel Suarez face off in an intense card game.

videos.title: Protector
videos.overview: Colonel Suarez offers Tanggol's group a deal, proposing that Augustus becomes their protector. Rigor informs Marites about Lena's death, only to be pushed away by his wife.

videos.title: Negotiation
videos.overview: Returning to an empty home, Rigor is haunted by regret over the choices that shattered his family. Tanggol wrestles with a tough decision as Augustus and Colonel Suarez demand a hefty payment to safeguard their drug operation.

videos.title: Alliance
videos.overview: David grows concerned when Olga reveals Ramon's meeting with Marites, while the two secretly conspire with Atty. Vera to alter Don Julio’s will. Tensions rise as Tanggol sees red over sharing profits with Augustus to protect their drug business.

videos.title: Bad News
videos.overview: Fulfilling his part of the deal, Augustus instructs Colonel Suarez to erase all records of the recent checkpoint encounter. Tanggol abandons everything when he learns of Noy’s sudden passing.

videos.title: Anger and Grief
videos.overview: Santino violently confronts Happy and Ghersie for stealing his savings, much to Annika's dismay. Tanggol seethes with anger upon learning of Lena's involvement in Noy's death.

videos.title: Family Father
videos.overview: Divina seeks assistance from Augustus and Colonel Suarez in transacting with their drug clients. Tanggol flies into a rage as he comes face-to-face with Rigor.

videos.title: Santino's Complained
videos.overview: Mourning turns into a tense confrontation when Rigor spots Tanggol in his house, prompting the barangay chairman to move Noy's wake elsewhere. Augustus and Colonel Pacheco prove their usefulness when Divina is double-crossed by a potential client.

videos.title: Family
videos.overview: Seizing the chance to confront Tanggol about their daughter's whereabouts, Marsing and Nita are devastated to learn the heartbreaking truth about Mokang. Ramon races home after an urgent call from David.

videos.title: Holding the Neck
videos.overview: Rigor continues to be haunted by the aftermath of his involvement with Lena. As an intense face-off breaks out between them, Olga reveals all the sinister acts she did to Ramon.

videos.title: Grenade
videos.overview: Chaos erupts as Augustus launches a brutal assault on Primo's group, forcing them into a desperate escape. Ramon narrowly survives Olga's treachery. Tensions boil over in Quiapo when Edwin learns about Mokang's tragic fate.

videos.title: Attack
videos.overview: Ramon vows to take revenge on Olga. While Berting starts questioning their group's fight, Primo decides to confront Augustus head-on. At Noy's funeral, Edwin beats up Santino for letting Tanggol escape.

videos.title: Rejection
videos.overview: Rigor springs into action after uncovering a suspicious detail about the recent checkpoint incident. Tanggol's heartfelt reunion with Tindeng turns into heartbreak as Marites remains distant and cold toward him.

videos.title: No Vengeance Love
videos.overview: Tindeng tries to reason with Marites after discovering her daughter's motive for rejecting Tanggol's help. Ramon commands his men to search the mansion's vicinity following Olga's revelation about Mokang.

videos.title: Remaining Corpse
videos.overview: Ramon silently grieves as he receives Mokang’s cremated remains. Edwin informs Lucio and his gang about Santino saving his brother. Tanggol learns about Augustus and Colonel Suarez's actions during Divina's botched meeting with a potential client.

videos.title: End of the Alliance
videos.overview: Augustus ends his alliance with Red Phoenix, leaving them confounded by his sudden decision. Rigor attempts to woo Marites with a bouquet of flowers. Meanwhile, Tanggol opens up to Divina, unleashing a lifetime’s worth of anger and pain.

videos.title: A Mother's Hatred
videos.overview: Discovering that Bubbles' remains are missing, Olga's urge to get revenge on the Dimaguibas reaches a fever pitch. Santino stands his ground against Rigor. To the concern of Tanggol's friends, Divina tells them their next transaction.

videos.title: Secret Revenge
videos.overview: Colonel Suarez loses his composure when Rigor reveals he is investigating the checkpoint incident. Upon learning of Noy's death, Olga devises a sinister plan to exact revenge on Tanggol and the Dimaguibas.

videos.title: Final Destination
videos.overview: David starts plotting against Olga, realizing she will go to any lengths for her vengeance. Tanggol returns to Quiapo to join his family and neighbors in Noy's funeral procession, unaware of a looming danger on his path.

videos.title: Olga's True Color
videos.overview: After detonating the bomb hidden in Noy's casket, Olga orders her men to confirm Tanggol's death. However, her plan unravels when Tanggol regains consciousness and fights back against her henchmen.

videos.title: Captive for Tanggol
videos.overview: Wanting to use Marites and Tindeng as bait against Tanggol, Olga wreaks havoc at the hospital to hunt them down. Tanggol reunites with his grandmother, who informs him about Marites' dire situation.

videos.title: That's My Son
videos.overview: Tanggol finds himself in a perilous situation as he comes to his mother's rescue. Marites pounces on the opportunity to strike back at their foe, but not before Olga reveals to Tanggol the truth about his identity.

videos.title: Transaction
videos.overview: Rigor and Mando recognize a lifeless body at the hospital. Col. Suarez agrees to meet a powerful client, unaware that both the Red Phoenix and Primo's group are planning separate attacks against him. Tanggol's gang returns to their hideout.

videos.title: Ambush
videos.overview: David devises a plan to keep Marites away from the Montenegros. Ramon confirms Olga's death. Ignoring his injuries and his friends' pleas, Tanggol gives in to his rage as he storms out to confront Rigor, unaware of the danger coming his way.

videos.title: Tanggol's Anger
videos.overview: Lucio retreats with his group, leaving Roy and Richardson locked in a firefight with Divina and Augustus' allies. Still consumed by rage after the clash, Tanggol bolts toward Rigor's location.

videos.title: Drive-by
videos.overview: Tanggol ignores his friends' warnings and unleashes his deep-seated wrath on Rigor. Marites and Tindeng argue about Tanggol's reaction after learning his true identity, causing David to panic upon overhearing their discussion.

videos.title: Clashed with the Friends
videos.overview: As David continues to sow seeds of doubt on him, Rigor recalls the evidence hinting that Marites could be involved with another man. Tanggol's friends chide him for his attempt on Rigor's life, leading to a heated argument.

videos.title: Visitor
videos.overview: Urged by Divina to just forget about his family, Tanggol considers finding his real father. Realizing their mistake, Tanggol's friends attempt to make peace with him.

videos.title: Visited
videos.overview: Tanggol's gang scrambles into action after their troubled friend vanishes from the mansion without a word. David faces a dilemma as he catches Ramon eavesdropping on Rigor and Marites' heated argument.

videos.title: Raged
videos.overview: Marsing and Nita discover Ramon hiding in their home, seizing the chance to uncover the truth about Mokang's fate. After confronting Tindeng for deceiving him, Tanggol unleashes his fury in Quiapo while hunting for Rigor.

videos.title: Catch Up
videos.overview: While Ramon finally gives in to Marites' request, Tanggol decides to just wait for Rigor. Primo and Amanda's plan against Colonel Suarez goes awry. A heated argument erupts at the police precinct.

videos.title: Face Off
videos.overview: Dead seat on becoming the next leader of Red Phoenix, Lucio gives Santino a heads up about his next mission. All hell breaks loose as Tanggol comes face-to-face with Rigor.

videos.title: Real Father
videos.overview: Horrified by Tanggol's warning, Marites frantically searches for Rigor, only to be met with the devastating scene of her husband and son's violent confrontation.

videos.title: Forget the Family
videos.overview: As Rigor is rushed to the hospital, Tanggol reflects on his hardships while racing back to his base. Meanwhile, Lucio puts Santino's loyalty to the test by assigning him an assassination mission.

videos.title: Disciplined
videos.overview: While the Red Phoenix revels in Lucio's rise as their new leader, Santino seethes with anger over Rigor's fate. Tensions escalate as Ramon and David clash over the chaos in Quiapo. Tanggol sets out to uncover the truth about his father.

videos.title: New Enemy
videos.overview: David scrambles to stop Ramon from crossing paths with Tanggol. Fueled by rage, Santino vows revenge against his brother for attacking Rigor. Divina briefs her group on the aftermath of the recent clash at their gambling den.

videos.title: Family Formation
videos.overview: Primo grows determined to rescue Amanda, unaware of Tanggol's brewing anger against him. Meanwhile, Tanggol considers asking for Augustus' help in finding his real father. Ramon decides to take Marites, much to David's surprise.

videos.title: Hold on to the Knife
videos.overview: Furious after learning Tanggol attacked Rigor, Ramon lashes out at David before heading to the hospital. Tanggol strikes a deal with Augustus, joining his plan in exchange for information about his father.

videos.title: Target
videos.overview: After visiting Rigor at the hospital, David moves quickly to execute his plan and keep his secret hidden from the Montenegros and his family. Primo gathers more men as he prepares to rescue Amanda and bring down Augustus.

videos.title: Service
videos.overview: David and his men attempt to escape after failing to take Ramon down with a single shot. Primo becomes even more determined to rescue Amanda after a disturbing call from Augustus.

videos.title: Wating
videos.overview: Rigor suffers the consequence of his action despite his desperate attempt to save his career. Primo's faction and Tanggol's group, now named Wating, prepare for their respective missions.

videos.title: Box
videos.overview: Marites is left devastated when Rigor blames her and Tanggol for his misfortunes. David rouses Ramon's suspicions. Oblivious to Augustus' surprise, Wating and the Mamba Cartel begin their transaction.

videos.title: Four Groups
videos.overview: As Lucio solidifies his grip on Quiapo as the new Red Phoenix leader, he selects a right-hand man from his ranks. Chaos erupts when Divina and the Mamba Cartel discover Amanda inside the box they were trading.

videos.title: Amanda
videos.overview: Tanggol's gang and Primo's group unite after realizing they have fallen into Augustus' trap. However, tensions rise when Tanggol and Primo turn their guns on each other, standing on opposite sides of the fight.

videos.title: Primo and Amanda
videos.overview: Tanggol and Primo put their feud on hold when Augustus' men arrive to take them down. Amid the chaos, Primo makes a bold sacrifice to protect his protégé and seize his chance for revenge against his mortal enemy.

videos.title: Face to Face
videos.overview: Edwin questions Lucio's decision to pick Santino as his right-hand man, sparking violent tension among the group. Marites agrees to go with Ramon and confront Tanggol to finally get answers to all her questions.

videos.title: Exposed
videos.overview: David panics upon seeing Ramon with Marites. With the truth out in the open, Ramon flies into a rage when he realizes that David was the one who tried to kill him.

videos.title: Broken Pretense
videos.overview: Worried for her son's safety, Marites begs Ramon to spare David's life. Tension mounts in the Dimaguiba household as Rigor returns from the hospital. Divina assures her group that Primo and Amanda's sacrifices were not in vain.

videos.title: Bet
videos.overview: Marites confides in Tindeng that the Montenegros are hunting one of her sons. David plots his escape by enticing Atty. Vera to fast-track the transfer of the Caballeros' wealth to his name. Tanggol and his group reopen their gambling den.

videos.title: Ownership
videos.overview: Rigor suffers a brutal beating at the hands of his neighbors. As Tanggol and Divina devise a plan to catch Ramon's attention, David unknowingly gambles away his money at his half-brother's den.

videos.title: Real and Pretend
videos.overview: Unable to reach Marites and find David, Ramon decides to hunt the latter in Quiapo. Tanggol unleashes his deep-seated anger on his half-brother as he confronts him for using his real identity.

videos.title: Philanderer
videos.overview: Despite his friends' warning, Tanggol vows to kill David and Rigor for all the things they've done to him. Marites confronts David and tries to expose his lies to Rigor.

videos.title: Payback
videos.overview: Rigor flies into a rage upon learning from Marites the truth behind David's injuries, unaware that Tanggol and Ramon are closing in, ready to make him and his son face the consequences of their actions.

videos.title: Father and Son
videos.overview: The turmoil in Quiapo reaches its peak as Tanggol spots and confronts Mokang's husband while hunting down Rigor and David. Marites intervenes, revealing the truth to stop Ramon and her son from killing each other.

videos.title: Arrested
videos.overview: Rigor erupts in anger upon seeing Marites at the hospital, demanding her arrest for aiding his enemies' escape. Tanggol pushes the pedal to the metal, desperately evading the authorities as he rushes to get an injured Ramon to safety.

videos.title: Treated
videos.overview: Tindeng and Roda rush to the police station upon learning of Marites' situation. Tanggol manages to escape from the cops but soon grows conflicted about Ramon.

videos.title: Son
videos.overview: Tindeng worries for her grandson now that he is with his real father. Meanwhile, Tanggol and Ramon open their hearts to each other, unaware that the cops are closing in on them.

videos.title: Companion
videos.overview: David weaves a web of lies when Rigor demands an explanation for impersonating his half-brother. Tanggol and Ramon join forces in a fierce battle against the police trying to take them down.

videos.title: Tangled Heart
videos.overview: Santino struggles to process Marites' justification for aiding his half-brother's escape. As Tanggol recounts the events in San Dimas to his friends, Ramon becomes determined to repair his fractured bond with his son.

videos.title: Weighing
videos.overview: While Tindeng fights tirelessly for her daughter's freedom, Rigor refuses to back down on sending Marites to jail. As the Montenegros prepare to welcome their lost heir, Tanggol grapples with his choices, haunted by his painful past.

videos.title: No One Left Behind
videos.overview: To allay his friends' fears, Tanggol promises to never leave them despite being a Montenegro. As news of his reappearance spreads in Quiapo, Ramon thinks of someone who can help him cover his tracks.

videos.title: Mayor
videos.overview: Santino informs Lucio about his half-brother's connection to the Montenegros. While en route to meet with Ramon, Tanggol gets cut off on the road. Elsewhere, tension brews between the two highest-ranking officials of the city.

videos.title: Car Chase
videos.overview: Rigor visits the police precinct to persuade the new station commander to hunt down his mortal enemy, oblivious to the greater forces at play. After securing Marites' bail, Ramon urges her to rebuild a family with Tanggol.

videos.title: Hug
videos.overview: Marites asks Ramon for time to process everything he revealed. Roberto erupts in anger when Miguelito announces his decision to leave politics. Tanggol and his gang arrive at the Montenegros' mansion.

videos.title: Dropped Wallet
videos.overview: A family's scam takes a disastrous turn when their unsuspecting victims decide to call the police. During a walk on the Montenegros' estate, Ramon shares his plan to give Tanggol the family he never had.

videos.title: Farewell
videos.overview: A commotion erupts between the Dimaguibas and their neighbors anew, prompting their barangay chairman to reach out to Roberto for help. Meanwhile, Tanggol bids final goodbye to Mokang.

videos.title: Accepted
videos.overview: An unfortunate incident befalls the Benitos as they attempt to escape from the police. Just when Don Julio feels hopeful about his family's future, Tanggol finally makes a life-changing decision.

videos.title: Invitation
videos.overview: Don Julio invites the Guerreros to a grand celebration where the Montenegros plan to present Tanggol to their powerful allies. Fatima makes a heartbreaking decision to afford her brother's life-saving surgery.

videos.title: The Sacrifice of Fatima
videos.overview: Fatima hurries back to the hospital with Miguelito's payment, only to be met with devastating news along the way. Tanggol and his gang arrive at the Montenegros' high-profile event.

videos.title: Face-Off
videos.overview: Fatima breaks down in tears, overwhelmed with regret for breaking her promise to Caloy in a desperate attempt to save his life. Miguelito draws his gun when a fight breaks out between his bodyguards and the men who tried to overtake his car.

videos.title: Introduction
videos.overview: Santino covers up for Marites and claims that he bailed her out, unknowingly arousing David and Rigor's suspicions about him. The Montenegros finally introduce Tanggol as their heir.

videos.title: Promise
videos.overview: Santino and the new Red Phoenix unknowingly encounter a member of a prominent family in a transaction that goes awry. Tanggol gladly accepts his new life and makes a promise to everyone.

videos.title: The Two Clans
videos.overview: Tanggol and Miguelito set aside their differences as Don Julio formally introduces the Montenegros' heir to the Guerreros. Don Gustavo stuns everyone with a major announcement about the upcoming elections.

videos.title: The Pride of Guerrero
videos.overview: Feeling betrayed by her family, Olivia storms out after Don Gustavo declares Miguelito as their mayoral candidate. Don Julio and Ramon explain to Tanggol the importance of maintaining a strong alliance with the Guerreros.

videos.title: Heritage
videos.overview: Lucio is shocked to learn that the person Santino rescued from the authorities belongs to a powerful political family. Gustavo pressures Miguelito to set aside Olivia's feelings and accept his decision. Ramon gives Tanggol a precious gift.

videos.title: Responsibility
videos.overview: Olivia and Jackie carefully consider their respective plans to gain political power. Rigor, still bothered by Marites' infidelity, attempts to force himself on his wife.

videos.title: Church
videos.overview: To ensure that Marites does not meet Ramon, Rigor prohibits his wife from leaving their house. Tindeng is shaken to the core as the Guerreros show up to Quiapo to present a united front to their constituents.

videos.title: Ally
videos.overview: Tindeng grapples with the lingering pain of Don Gustavo's past actions. After the Guerreros' church visit in Quiapo, Miguelito heads to Tanggol's hideout to assess the truth worth of his potential business partner.

videos.title: Negotiation
videos.overview: Bracing for a showdown with the Montenegros, Ramon and David acquire firearms with Vera's assistance. Tanggol strategizes his next move as he and Miguelito arrange to meet at a drifting competition to negotiate the sale of his priceless gemstones.

videos.title: Mayor
videos.overview: Olivia pleads with Roberto to let her run for mayor instead of Miguelito, only to be devastated by her brother's reasoning for denying her request. Tanggol strategizes his next move against Miguelito and his business partners.

videos.title: Tindeng's Nightmare
videos.overview: Tanggol plans to return to San Dimas to aid the locals financially, despite the danger of crossing paths with Rigor and David again. Olivia vows to get the power she longs for. Tindeng's past continues to haunt her.

videos.title: The Imprisonment of Marites
videos.overview: While David closely follows Santino to confirm his suspicion of him, Rigor locks Marites up as he goes out to look for a new job. Tanggol's group prepares for their underhanded scheme against Miguelito, confident that they won't get caught.

videos.title: True Value
videos.overview: Out of concern for Marites, Santino pleads with Angkong to spare David from harm. Rigor tries his luck applying for a job at a security agency. Tanggol challenges Migueltio to a high-stakes racing competition.

videos.title: Race
videos.overview: Rigor spirals into a life of crime as he seeks ways to fund his vendetta against the Montenegros. Olivia breaks out in a cold sweat as Lorenzo's men prepare to assassinate Roberto. The high-stakes race between Tanggol and Miguelito begins.

videos.title: Negotiation
videos.overview: Wracked with guilt and despair, Rigor begs Mando to put him behind bars for his crime. Ramon negotiates a major deal for their newest business venture. Tanggol and Miguelito's race reaches fever pitch.

videos.title: Plan C
videos.overview: Rigor goes to the city hall to attend a job expo that Roberto organized. Tanggol executes their daring plan as Team Waiting makes a move to steal the drugs from Miguelito's associates.

videos.title: Victory
videos.overview: Rigor jumps into action to save Roberto from Olivia's henchmen, while Maki finds himself in hot water when the police arrive. Tanggol manages to slip back into the race.

videos.title: Captured
videos.overview: Tanggol and his friends celebrate the success of their mission. The police arrest Rigor in connection with the attempt on Roberto's life. Olivia conceals her fear as the Guerreros delve into the possible motives behind the assassination plot.

videos.title: Thanksgiving
videos.overview: Roberto goes to the police station to personally order colonel Romero to release Rigor, vowing to help his savior return to service. A worried Tindeng urges her daughter to run away with her for safety.

videos.title: Anger
videos.overview: While Tindeng spends the night on the streets, Roda persuades Rigor to let him stay at his place. Lucio decides to release David, seeing potential in using him the way he did Santino. Tanggol's friends urge him to help his grandmother.

videos.title: The Accused
videos.overview: Pressured by Roberto, Colonel Romero orders his men to beat up Maki and forces him to talk. As the Benitos orchestrate a plan for Maki's bail, Tanggol's group heads to San Dimas to give out money to the locals.

videos.title: Assistance
videos.overview: Despite Colonel Romero's stern warning, Rigor sets his sights on Ramon now that he is back in service. Tanggol's group seeks their friends' help in spreading the news about their good deed.

videos.title: Tanggol's Money
videos.overview: Ramon seethes with anger after Roberto refuses to grant his request. Before handing out money to his neighbors in Quiapo, Tanggol instructs a friend to deliver a wad of cash to Tindeng. Meanwhile, Fatima devises a plan to secure Maki's bail.

videos.title: Car Break-In
videos.overview: Ramon jumps into action upon receiving a distressing call from Marites. Despite Tanggol's kindness toward their family, Fatima and Nognog hatch a scheme to get more money from the unsuspecting benefactor.

videos.title: Escape
videos.overview: With his life on the line, Tanggol is forced to do Fatima's bidding. Though Marites manages to escape and reunite with him, Ramon clashes with David in an intense confrontation.

videos.title: Visitor of the Benito
videos.overview: As David updates rigor on his mother's escape, Marites expresses her growing concern for her family. Tindeng hurries home upon hearing that Tanggol is in San Dimas. The Benitos bring home Fatima's unconscious victim.

videos.title: Kidnap
videos.overview: Lucio entrusts Santino with leading the Red Phoenix in delivering products to one of their loyal clients. Paeng devises a risky plan as the Benitos argue over their next move with their captive.

videos.title: Tindeng's Fury
videos.overview: Tindeng unleashes her fury upon learning the real reason behind Marites' escape from Rigor's house. As the Montenegros scramble to save their heir, Paeng hatches a plan to demand a hefty ransom for Tanggol.

videos.title: Ransom
videos.overview: Crossing paths with David at the gambling house, Miguelito invites him into a game. Santino encounters Erika while waiting for Iñigo. Meanwhile, Paeng strikes a deal with Ramon in exchange for Tanggol's freedom.

videos.title: Prisoner of the Benito Family
videos.overview: Though he wins against Miguelito in their game, David still honors his bet in hopes of gaining the congressman's favor. While the Benitos grow fearful of their plan, Tanggol's family and friends prepare for the deal.

videos.title: New Homes
videos.overview: Marites and Roda find a small room to rent. After telling Santino that Marites abandoned them, Rigor vows to reunite with his family. Tanggol warns the Benitos about the danger they are walking into.

videos.title: Ransom
videos.overview: Don Julio intervenes as Rigor demands to confront Ramon and Marites. At the park where the ransom exchange is set, Paeng urges his family to stick to his plan, warning that one wrong move could put their lives at risk.

videos.title: Tracker
videos.overview: Fatima steps on the gas to flee with the ransom money, unaware that Tanggol's friends are hot on her trail. Colonel Romero scolds Rigor for endangering his men in his relentless pursuit of Ramon.

videos.title: Survey
videos.overview: Amid tension over the latest mayoral survey, Roberto and Miguelito express their desire to sever their ties with the Montenegros. While Ramon seethes with anger due to his friends' failture to rescue him, Tanggol returns to the Benitos.

videos.title: Family Reunion
videos.overview: David challenges Miguelito to another game and gamles the Caballero properties he earned. Tanggol reunites with his family and friends after fulfilling his promises to the Benitos.

videos.title: Danger to Marites
videos.overview: After beating David, Miguelito instructs his henchman to verify the land titles he obtained. Maki discovers the sacrifices his family made to secure his ail. Tanggol fumes during his reunion with Marites at the Montenegro mansion.

videos.title: The Change of Life
videos.overview: Fatima starts searching for a job as her family strives to turn over a new leaf. Despite Don Julio's change of heart about reuniting the family, Ramon pleads with Marites to stay by his side.

videos.title: Acts of Sabotage
videos.overview: Santino gets to know Erika on a deeper level after she gets into a fight at the club. While Tanggol plots to sabotage the Montenegros' drug shipment to stop its circulation, Olivia seizes a chance to take down Roberto and MIguelito.

videos.title: Kwon
videos.overview: Iñigo learns of a drug better than Red Chaser and tasks Santino to get hold of it. As he stands by his plan against his family, Tanggol heads to the Montenegro mansion for their transaction with the Kwons.

videos.title: Transaction at the Pier
videos.overview: While everyone is heading to the pier for the drug shipment, Tanggol updates Divina about their mission. Upon ensuring that his men are ready to go full force, Roberto and his family meet with the Montenegros and the Kwons.

videos.title: End of the Alliance
videos.overview: Fatima shares the news about her new job at Jessa and Loisa's boutique. Roda rushes into Al's room after hearing a loud thud. Tensions rise as the alliance between the Montenegros and the Guerreros shatters when authorities arrive at the port.

videos.title: Attack at the Pier
videos.overview: Chaos erupts when anti-drug officers storm the port, allowing Tanggol and his team to seize the precious cargo. A vengeful pair of eyes catches sight of Marites inside the Montenegros' mansion.

videos.title: Taking Back from Marites
videos.overview: As the Montenegros return home after their failed deal at the port, Rigor sneaks into their mansion in search for Marites. Tanggol soon shows up with news about the Kwons' cargo, prompting Ramon to lose his temper.

videos.title: Eviction
videos.overview: As he finds the Guerreros' reputation on the line, Roberto grows convinced that the Montenegros betrayed his family and plots against them in return. Ramon pressures his ally to locate the missing drugs. Tanggol learns about Rigor's intrusion.

videos.title: To Switch Sides
videos.overview: Roberto plans a raid on Ramon's warehouse, unaware that the crime lord is one step ahead of him. Fatima begins her job at Jessa and Loisa's boutique. Disowned by her own family, Olivia goes to the Montenegros to seek alliance.

videos.title: The Vice
videos.overview: Fatima visits one of Loi and Frida's wealthy clients, only to discover she is none other than Miguelito's mother. Olivia devises a bold plan to prove her loyalty to the Montenegros.

videos.title: Fatima's Silence
videos.overview: After stopping Miguelito from assaulting Fatima, Jackie devises a plan to restore the Guerreros' reputation. Marites voices her concern after overhearing Ramon and Don Julio urging Tanggol to run for office.

videos.title: Politics and Family
videos.overview: Jackie and Miguelito visit Fatima's community as part of their plan to divert public attention amid growing rumors about their alleged drug ties. Tanggol updates his friends on Olivia's recent visit to the Montenegros.

videos.title: Fatima's Suitor
videos.overview: While Fatima questions Miguelito's true intentions for showing up at her doorstep, Jackie makes a move to win over the Benitos. Tanggol reflects on his arduous path to success and finally reaches a decision about Olivia's offer.

videos.title: Council Members
videos.overview: As the Guerreros strategize to regain public support after the port fiasco, Olivia grows uneasy when Tanggol lays out his conditions for accepting the vice mayoral bid.

videos.title: The Congressman
videos.overview: While the Guerreros clash over Jackie's publicity stunt, Paeng and Gracia butt heads over Miguelito's pursuit of Fatima. Tanggol heads back to San Dimas with Olivia, determined to win Chairman Mojica's support for his political bid.

videos.title: The True Colors of the Guerrero
videos.overview: The Guerreros receive a warm welcome upon their arrival in Quiapo. Unknown to the public, the true nature of this political family is far from admirable. Tanggol rallies his supporters as he prepares to run for vice mayor.

videos.title: Encounter
videos.overview: Lucio offers Paeng a lucrative opportunity. Tindeng breaks into a cold sweat after Marites reveals her grandson's bold plan. Before meeting his potential councilors, Tanggol rescues a group of junk collectors from Roberto's men.

videos.title: Matilde's Past
videos.overview: Tindeng flees in fear after Pilar recognizes her in Quiapo, triggering a revelation about her dark past and the only man she ever loved. Tanggol springs into action when a fire erupts in the slums.

videos.title: To Rescue
videos.overview: As Olivia seizes the chaos caused by the fire in the slums, Tanggol risks his life to rescue and evacuate residents trapped inside their burning homes.

videos.title: Mayor
videos.overview: Moved by his heroic act, the fire victims chant Tanggol’s name and urge him to run for mayor. David loses his temper after hearing about his half-brother’s plans, unaware that Miguelito is already hunting him down.

videos.title: Rigodon
videos.overview: Jackie threatens Fatima to cooperate with the Guerreros' campaign, while Paeng lands in serious trouble after accepting a job order from Lucio. Olivia tries to ride on Tanggol's coattails to secure funding from the Montenegros.

videos.title: Candidates for Mayor
videos.overview: After seeing his son's viral video, Ramon decides to push Tanggol to run for mayor instead of Olivia. Worried about their rival's rising popularity, Jackie urges Miguelito to win over Fatima to outshine the opposing camp.

videos.title: Decision
videos.overview: Tanggol tells his friends about Ramon's plan to have him run for mayor in place of Olivia. Miguelito retaliates against David for deceiving him. Don Julio urges his son to reconsider his decision, but to no avail.

videos.title: New Beginning
videos.overview: Marites finally opens her heart to Ramon. The police arrest Erika during a drug raid at the bar she and Santino frequent. Before launching his political bid, Tanggol urges his friends to change, believing transformation must begin with them.

videos.title: Olivia's Surprise
videos.overview: Mr. Kwon warns the Montenegros that they risk losing their credibility if they fail to pay him. While the Guerreros prepare for the filing of candidacy, Olivia arrives at the election commission to inform Tanggol about her decision.

videos.title: Speech
videos.overview: Ramon and his men go after Mr. Kwon. Chaos erupts during the filing of candidacy as Tanggol and Miguelito engage in a heated brawl following the latter's insulting remarks.

videos.title: Imprisoned Candidate
videos.overview: Gustavo confronts Olivia about her alliance with the Montenegros. As Don Julio pulls strings to get his grandson out of jail, Miguelito and Roberto wield their power and influence to derail Tanggol’s political ambitions.

videos.title: Payback
videos.overview: Worried that Tanggol might be freed before meeting his end behind bars, Miguelito orders David to assassinate him outside the police station. When the hit fails, Miguelito is left with no choice but to take matters into his own hands.

videos.title: Clan Against Clan
videos.overview: As the Guerreros gear up for an all-out war, Tanggol vows revenge for the attempt on his life. David bears the brunt of Miguelito's fury as he explains why he failed to eliminate his half-brother.

videos.title: Older Brother
videos.overview: To prove her loyalty to the Montenegros, Olivia discloses the location of the Guerreros' motorcade on the first day of the campaign period. Miguelito tests Vera's obedience by ordering her to eliminate David.

videos.title: Motorcade
videos.overview: Gustavo smears the Montenegros' image to gain the elites' support in the upcoming elections. Tanggol and Miguelito kick off their campaign with grand motorcades, during which David attempts to warn his brother about the Guerreros' plan.

videos.title: Siblings
videos.overview: Fearing her family's reaction as her bar video goes viral, Erika begs Santino to take her somewhere her parents cannot find her. Tanggol catches sight of David during a shootout between his group and Miguelito's men.

videos.title: Forgiveness
videos.overview: Tanggol teams up with David as they battle several men in pursuit of Miguelito. The chase takes a deadly turn when David breaks away, determined to corner and make their target pay.

videos.title: Mourning
videos.overview: As Ramon, Tanggol, and their group make their escape, Rigor discovers David’s lifeless body in an abandoned building. Marites comes across David’s belongings in her room, unaware of the tragedy that has befallen her son.

videos.title: Coffin
videos.overview: Santino takes Erika to the Red Phoenix’s hideout for safety. Marites begs Ramon to let her see David one last time. Fueled by grief and rage, Tanggol vows to make the Guerreros pay for his half-brother’s death.

videos.title: Wake
videos.overview: While the Guerreros plan their next move against Tanggol, the Dimaguibas mourn their loss following David's untimely demise. Later at David's wake, Rigor erupts in rage upon finding Marites weeping over their son.

videos.title: The Secrets of the Guerreros
