videos.overview: While Fatima attempts to escape the Guerreros' mansion, a can of worms bursts open when Olivia arrives to confront Pilar about Don Julio's shocking claim. Ramon decides to head to San Dimas out of concern for Marites.

videos.title: Forgiveness
videos.overview: Marites risks her life when Santino tries to shoot Tanggol in a desperate attempt to save Rigor. Chaos erupts in the Benito household as a shaken Fatima returns home and reveals the horrors she witnessed during the motorcade incident.

videos.title: The Benito Family
videos.overview: The Benitos are forced to flee when Miguelito's men unleash a hail of bullets on their home in a bid to silence Fatima. As Tanggol urges Ramon to brace for Rigor's retaliation, Santino seethes with fury while standing before David's lifeless body.

videos.title: For David
videos.overview: Roberto breaks into a cold sweat upon receiving alarming news about Erika. As Miguelito and his men close in, the Benitos are forced to flee and leave Gracia behind. Tanggol remains determined to give David a proper burial.

videos.title: Outsider
videos.overview: Facing Roberto's wrath for abducting his daughter, Lucio attempts to negotiate with the mayor to save himself. Olivia reveals her true identity to Ramon, igniting rivalry between them over the Montenegos' wealth and power.

videos.title: Procession for David
videos.overview: As Olivia exploits Don Julio’s soft spot for her, Ramon firmly rejects the idea of accepting her into their family. Tanggol and his friends race to the cemetery upon learning of Rigor’s plan to bury David unceremoniously.

videos.title: David's Burial
videos.overview: Erika is repulsed after uncovering her family’s dark secret. After reclaiming David’s body from Rigor, Tanggol and his friends are forced into a perilous chase when the police unexpectedly arrive.

videos.title: The Truth
videos.overview: Olivia devises a plan to deepen the rift between Ramon and Don Julio. The Guerreros are thrown into disarray after learning that Tanggol is leading a trusted pre-election survey. Fatima finds a glimmer of hope after laying Gracia to rest.

videos.title: The Aces
videos.overview: After releasing his subordinate, Colonel Romero informs Rigor that the mayor wants to see him. As Tanggol asks the Benitos if they are willing to help expose the Guerreros, Lucio and his men prepare to carry out Roberto’s order.

videos.title: Miting de Avance
videos.overview: Tindeng decides to leave, even if it means hurting Alfredo all over again in the process. Ramon sets aside his distrust of Olivia to ensure Tanggol’s campaign runs smoothly ahead of the miting de avance.

videos.title: Response
videos.overview: Fatima brushes off Paeng’s concerns, staying firm in her resolve to expose the Guerreros to the public. Olivia grows uneasy as Pilar’s warning lingers in her mind. Tanggol’s friends catch sight of Santino at the Montenegros’ campaign rally.

videos.title: Revealing the Truth
videos.overview: As Rigor delivers his speech at the Guerreros' campaign rally, Fatima bravely steps forward to expose Miguelito's atrocities, casting doubt on Santino’s resolve to take revenge on Tanggol for David’s death.

videos.title: Explosion
videos.overview: While the Guerreros continue to woo voters by boasting about their family's accomplishments and attacking their opponents, Tanggol delivers a moving speech about his desire to serve the public, unaware of the bomb being planted right under his feet.

videos.title: Downfall and Betrayal
videos.overview: While chasing the Red Phoenix after the explosion, Enteng and the gang spot Santino fighting alongside Lucio and Edwin. As doctors tend to Tanggol’s wounds, Olivia breaks down upon receiving tragic news.

videos.title: Blood of the Guerreros
videos.overview: Tindeng returns to Quiapo Church in a desperate attempt to retrieve the very item that led her to hide her past from Marites. As the Guerreros panic upon learning of Tanggol’s survival, Santino seizes the chance to avenge his brother.

videos.title: Seed of the Enemy
videos.overview: Santino runs into Erika while fleeing the Guerrero mansion after failing to assassinate Miguelito. Tanggol overhears Marites confiding in Ramon about Tindeng’s shocking revelation.

videos.title: Separated Guerreros
videos.overview: Erika persuades Santino to book a motel room as they hide from her family's men. Roberto confronts Lucio about the man who took his daughter. Olivia uncovers Pilar’s motive for confronting Tanggol’s grandmother.

videos.title: The Battle of Tanggol
videos.overview: Tension rises at the Guerrero mansion when Pilar comes home and blames Roberto for Iñigo's death. Rather than backing down, Tanggol grows even more determined to run for mayor and bring justice to the victims of the Guerreros.

videos.title: Mother's Anger
videos.overview: Olivia vows to exact revenge on all the Guerreros, including Marites and Tanggol. Soon, all hell breaks loose at the Montenegros' mansion when the grieving mother takes her pain and anger out on Marites upon returning home.

videos.title: Evict Marites
videos.overview: Tanggol hurries to Fatima’s side after discovering the Guerreros' role in the explosion at his campaign rally. As Don Julio and Ramon clash over Olivia, Marites decides to take matters into her own hands.

videos.title: Title and Cemetery
videos.overview: The Guerreros' press conference is abruptly cut short when Don Gustavo learns of the commotion outside their mansion. Tanggol and his friends arrive at the cemetery to rescue the Benitos from Roberto's men.

videos.title: Gustavo's Inheritance
videos.overview: Marites reveals that Tanggol is also a Guerrero and pleads with Don Gustavo to spare her son in exchange for the land titles she holds. Fatima's life is at risk when Colonel Romero corners her.

videos.title: Gustavo's Protection
videos.overview: Gustavo orders his family not to harm Marites and Tanggol anymore, only to fuel the Guerreros' desire to get back what rightfully belongs to them. With Tanggol's help, the Benitos take refuge.

videos.title: Welcoming
videos.overview: Tricked yet again by Lucio, Santino seethes with rage upon learning from Erika about the old man's connivance with Roberto. Tindeng and Alfredo find themselves in danger as Pilar's men suddenly arrive.

videos.title: Santino's Fight
videos.overview: Pilar’s plan to reclaim the Guerreros’ wealth begins to unfold after she abducts Tindeng. Realizing Lucio can no longer be trusted, Santino opens fire on his former allies as he and Erika make their escape from the Red Phoenix and Roberto’s men.

videos.title: Ransom
videos.overview: After bringing Erika back to his father’s house, Santino tries to convince Rigor that Miguelito is the one who killed David. Marites breaks out in a cold sweat upon receiving a call from Tindeng’s number.

videos.title: Pilar's Command
videos.overview: Following the Red Phoenix’s failed attempt to retrieve Erika, Roberto heads to the police station to question Rigor about Santino’s whereabouts. Tanggol and his friends gear up after learning that Tindeng is in grave danger.

videos.title: The Rescue
videos.overview: Santino lashes out at Erika for risking her safety by going out. Despite Olivia’s warning that Tanggol and Ramon are on their way, Pilar chooses to remain in her hideout.

videos.title: The Battle of Father and Son
videos.overview: Tanggol and Ramon join forces to rescue Tindeng from Pilar’s mercy. Despite their objections, Marites and Olivia frantically rush to the scene to save their respective mothers.

videos.title: The Rescue of Tindeng
videos.overview: Fatima urges her family to stay strong as Paeng and Maki begin to lose hope in their situation. While Ramon and Tanggol risk their lives to rescue Tindeng, Marites arrives just in time to stop Pilar from killing her.

videos.title: Forgiveness and Support
videos.overview: While Olivia frets over her mother’s condition, the Guerreros seize the opportunity to win public sympathy ahead of the upcoming elections. Tanggol finally understands why Tindeng never supported his mayoral bid.

videos.title: Mother
videos.overview: Suspecting Tanggol’s hand in his son’s death, Marsing turns to Rigor for help in seeking justice for Edwin. Santino panics upon spotting a wake at the Dimaculangans. Tindeng sheds tears of joy when Marites finally calls her “mother.”

videos.title: What Marites Prides On
videos.overview: Gustavo slips into Pilar’s room with the intent to assassinate her. Rigor orders Santino to pay his respects at Edwin’s wake. Tanggol and Ramon clash in a heated argument over their conflicting motives for claiming the mayoral seat.

videos.title: Disobedient
videos.overview: Election day finds the Guerreros at each other’s throats, scrambling to buy last-minute votes to catch up to Tanggol’s lead. Meanwhile, Tanggol stands firm against their family’s drug trade.

videos.title: Prayer Rally
videos.overview: Tanggol, his family, and his supporters hold a prayer rally as the city casts its votes for the next mayor. Miguelito starts to panic as he realizes that his opponent will come after him once the polls close.

videos.title: Clash at the Prayer Rally
videos.overview: Erika confides in Santino that she might be pregnant. Heeding Pilar’s plea, Olivia vows to stop the Guerreros from winning as she heads out to cast her vote. Rigor confronts Tanggol following the prayer rally.

videos.title: Election
videos.overview: Ramon leverages his son’s candidacy while negotiating with a powerful international drug supplier. Tension erupts into a heated confrontation when Tanggol and his family cross paths with the Guerreros at the election precinct.

videos.title: Chaos and Secrets
videos.overview: Santino reacts with disbelief when Erika confirms her pregnancy. Olivia exposes the Guerreros' dirty little secrets, intensifying the tension between Tanggol and his enemies.

videos.title: Attempt Before the Vote Count
videos.overview: Following Olivia's damaging attack on his family's reputation, a livid Gustavo sets out to settle the score in the cruelest way. Meanwhile, Roberto executes another sinister plan against Tanggol.

videos.title: Angkong's Trap
videos.overview: Roberto puts Miguelito in his place after his brother starts belittling him in light of Olivia’s revelations. Tanggol fights tooth and nail as the Red Phoenix and the Guerreros’ men close in on him.

videos.title: Explosion on the Bridge
videos.overview: Ramon and his son’s friends storm the Guerreros’ mansion after learning that Roberto’s men are hunting down Tanggol. Meanwhile, the Red Phoenix’s unrelenting pursuit drives their target over the edge.

videos.title: Montenegro's Wrath
videos.overview: As Ramon and his son’s friends retreat after unleashing the Montenegros’ wrath on the Guerreros, a bloodied Tanggol staggers into his family’s mansion. Olivia begins to set her plan in motion to bring down the family she once called her own.

videos.title: First Count of Votes
videos.overview: As Manila’s citizens follow the partial, unofficial election results, Olivia visits an old family friend as she takes the next step in her plan to shatter Roberto’s image beyond repair.

videos.title: Vote Manipulation
videos.overview: Olivia plants seeds of doubt in Pierre's mind about his relationship with Roberto. With Tanggol and Olivia pulling ahead in the unofficial election results, Roberto scrambles to turn the tide in favor of his family.

videos.title: Counting
videos.overview: Roberto stays composed while Miguelito and Jackie grow uneasy as their opponent maintains an early lead in the vote tally. Tanggol plots to sabotage Ramon’s upcoming drug deal with a foreign supplier.

videos.title: Father and Son's Confrontation
videos.overview: As Tanggol moves to disrupt his father’s drug transaction, Ramon and Marites clash over the Montenegros’ illicit dealings. Meanwhile, Tanggol’s supporters grow uneasy after the latest election update.

videos.title: Ramon's Transaction
videos.overview: Olivia watches with satisfaction as she begins tearing down Roberto’s image. A new OIC assumes command of Rigor’s police station. As Ramon secures a deal with an international drug supplier, Tanggol and his friends infiltrate the transaction site.

videos.title: Father and Son's Confrontation
videos.overview: Lt. Victorino summons Rigor to his office. Olivia sets her plan in motion, aiming to use Marites against both the Montenegros and the Guerreros. Tanggol and his gang withdraw after disrupting Ramon’s transaction.

videos.title: Expose
videos.overview: Santino gets reminded of his blissful past when he crosses paths with Annika. While Tanggol and Divina clash over the money they stole, an oblivious Ramon hunts down the masked thieves who robbed him of his goods.

videos.title: Disrespectful
videos.overview: Ramon is shaken to the core after unmasking the man who has been sabotaging his drug transactions. Roberto takes matters into his own hand when Pierre blackmails him. Olivia and his men attempt to move Marites out of the mansion.

videos.title: Battle of Principle
videos.overview: Erika confronts Santino about his relationship with Annika. After disposing of Pierre’s body, Roberto returns home to watch the election updates with his family. Ramon vows to make Tanggol pay for betraying the Montenegros.

videos.title: The Winner
videos.overview: Olivia hides Marites inside an oven when Ramon comes searching for her. The citizens of Manila hold their breath as the official and final election results are announced.

videos.title: Preparation for a Severe Attack
videos.overview: As Miguelito revels in his victory, Don Gustavo starts to suspect Roberto of orchestrating his election defeat. Ramon orders his men to prepare for the Guerreros’ retaliation.

videos.title: Montenegro's Power
videos.overview: The Dimaculangans celebrate the Guerreros' victory by mocking those who supported Tanggol. As the Montenegros rally their forces against their enemies, Tanggol tries to earn Ramon and Don Julio's forgiveness and regain their trust.

videos.title: The Newcomer
videos.overview: Santino confesses to Rigor that he got Erika pregnant. Roberto informs Miguelito and Jackie about his plan to bring down Tanggol along with the Montenegros. Two new officers are assigned to the Quiapo police station.

videos.title: To Cook
videos.overview: Olivia plots to finish off Marites before slipping out of the mansion. Roberto forces Hector to let Rigor take charge of the police operation against the Montenegros.

videos.title: Attack on Montenegro
videos.overview: Ramon seethes with rage after discovering Olivia’s attempt to kill Marites. As Don Julio moves to protect his daughter, the police and the Guerreros arrive at the mansion’s doorstep.

videos.title: Rigor's Victory
videos.overview: After chasing down his half-sister with the help of the Red Phoenix, Roberto struggles to steel his heart as he hesitates to finish off Olivia. Ramon attempts to flee with Marites as Rigor closes in on them.

videos.title: The Fall of the Montenegros
videos.overview: Don Julio discovers Divina's betrayal. Ramon hovers between life and death after facing off against Rigor. While the rest of the Montenegros' forces fall into police hands, Tanggol and his team manage to escape.

videos.title: Presscon
videos.overview: Tindeng urges a group of witnesses to testify against the Guerreros. While Tanggol and his friends take refuge at the Benitos’ hideout, Roberto and Miguelito hold a press conference to expose the Montenegros.

videos.title: The Flame of Defeat
videos.overview: Gustavo runs into Tindeng while visiting Marites in prison. Realizing that justice and integrity alone are not enough to prevail, Tanggol vows to avenge his family and sets his sights on uncovering the truth behind his election defeat.

videos.title: The Rescue of Ramon
videos.overview: Rigor and his men secure the hospital perimeter as Ramon recovers from his wounds. Aware of the danger awaiting him, Tanggol nevertheless sets out to rescue his father.

videos.title: The Sneaking Into the Hospital
videos.overview: As Roberto and Jackie entertain guests at their victory party, Tanggol and his friends slip past a horde of cops to infiltrate the hospital and rescue Ramon.

videos.title: One Word
videos.overview: Miguelito crosses paths with an old foe at his victory party. Meanwhile, Tanggol and his friends battle overwhelming odds as they race to save Ramon and make it out unharmed.

videos.title: Oweng
videos.overview: Rocky Boy and Miguelito come to blows, disrupting the Guerreros’ victory party. Tanggol is consumed with grief as he and his friends return to the Benitos’ hideout carrying Oweng’s lifeless body.

videos.title: Root of Corruption
videos.overview: The Guerreros and their political allies rejoice as they anticipate gaining access to their districts’ vast budgets. Haunted by Divina’s scathing words, Tanggol makes a heartbreaking decision to protect his friends.

videos.title: Victory and Defeat
videos.overview: Roberto cautions Miguelito and Jackie against greed when they push for larger cuts from their projects. After causing a scene at the victory party, Don Gustavo comes to the painful realization that he can no longer trust anyone in his family.

videos.title: The Farewell
videos.overview: Santino pleads with Rigor to release Marites. As Tanggol bids farewell to his friends and the Benitos, Roberto heads to the police station, determined to find a way to track him down.

videos.title: The Betrayal
videos.overview: In exchange for her and Emil's freedom, Divina betrays Tanggol and leads Rigor and Hector to his suspected hideout. A fierce confrontation soon follows between the authorities and Tanggol's group.

videos.title: The Oath of the New Mayor
videos.overview: Just before their oath-taking ceremony begins, the Guerreros are confronted by Tindeng, who vows to uncover the truth behind their suspicious win. Elsewhere, the gunfight turns into a deadly one-on-one battle between Tanggol's group and the police.

videos.title: Victim of Poverty
videos.overview: After the oath-taking ceremony, Roberto and Jackie cross paths with Tanggol’s councilors. The Red Phoenix confirms Erika’s whereabouts. Fatima loses control of herself after witnessing Paeng’s death.

videos.title: New Shelter
videos.overview: Desperate for refuge after her betrayal, Divina swallows her pride and returns to her family. Mauro lands in trouble when his creditors catch up with him. Tanggol awakens to heartbreaking news.

videos.title: Wheel of Fate
videos.overview: Santino tries to flee with Erika after learning that the Red Phoenix and the Guerreros are closing in on them. As Tanggol’s friends lament being back to square one, Divina reveals to her family the reason for her return.

videos.title: New Place, New Face
videos.overview: Santino insists on going with Erika to the Guerreros' mansion to protect her and find evidence proving Miguelito's involvement in David's death. While seeking refuge in a new place, Tanggol vows to exact revenge on his enemies one by one.

videos.title: Brawl at the Beerhouse
videos.overview: Moments after returning to the mansion with Erika, Miguelito viciously attacks Santino. Ramon feigns unconsciousness as he plans his escape. Tanggol and his friends rescue Mauro from the men he owes money to.

videos.title: New Victim
videos.overview: As Ponggay questions her decision to heed her family’s plea to let Tanggol go, Dimples endures unspeakable torment at the hands of Rocky Boy. Enteng urges his friends to find a way to earn money and secure ammunition.

videos.title: Pursuit of Freedom and Truth
videos.overview: Erika threatens to harm herself if her family lays a hand on Santino again. Overwhelmed with anguish as Dimples fights for her life after the horrific ordeal, Linda lashes out at Mauro, blaming him for their daughter’s suffering.

videos.title: Return to San Dimas
videos.overview: Ponggay uncovers Dimples’ dark secret as she seeks justice for her sister. While Tanggol and his friends set out to meet with Myrna, Tindeng returns to San Dimas to rally support for their electoral protest.

videos.title: Secret Meeting
videos.overview: Tanggol reunites with Tindeng and his political allies. Mauro lands in trouble after acting on his suspicions that his creditors were behind what happened to Dimples. Meanwhile, Santino endures cruelty inside the Guerreros’ mansion.

videos.title: Chasing Kidlat
videos.overview: Eager to know his grandson better, Don Gustavo asks Santino about the family he grew up with. Tindeng arrives at city hall for her first day on the job. Chaos erupts when Tanggol spots Kidlat in public.

videos.title: Tanggol's Decision
videos.overview: Ponggay gains access to case reports mirroring what happened to Dimples. Tanggol’s councilors push back against an unjust policy during a meeting. Tanggol makes a dangerous decision after confirming Ramon’s whereabouts.

videos.title: Own Mission
videos.overview: The Mondragons show Divina how they profit from substandard flood control projects. Tindeng confronts the Guerreros over the council’s approval of suspicious funds. Tanggol’s friends vow to stand by him through heaven and hell.

videos.title: Peak
videos.overview: After stepping down from his post to make way for Rigor, Hector takes Ponggay out on a date. Facundo discovers that Tindeng has returned to city hall. Tanggol arrives at the site where Ramon is being held by the Red Phoenix.

videos.title: Ramon's Second Life
videos.overview: Hector persists in pursuing Ponggay despite her clear rejection. Finding himself at death's door, Ramon repents and pleads for another chance to atone for his sins.

videos.title: Montenegro Father and Son
videos.overview: Ponggay devises a way to track down the man behind the Midnight Monster account. As Tanggol battles countless foes to save his father, Ramon summons his remaining strength to reach his son.

videos.title: Freed Father and Son
videos.overview: Enraged by Tanggol’s success in rescuing his father from the Red Phoenix, Miguelito turns his fury on Santino. Ramon asks his son’s friends about the fate of Marites and Don Julio.

videos.title: New Victim
videos.overview: Ramon apologizes to Tanggol, sharing his realizations after being given a second chance at life. Rocky Boy responds to his new victim, unaware that he is walking straight into a trap.

videos.title: The Revenge
videos.overview: With Ramon no longer in danger, Tanggol turns his focus to making Divina pay for her betrayal. Ponggay tells Chona that she is heading to Mondragon Hotel to meet with MysteryMan13.

videos.title: Freedom or the Opposite
videos.overview: Rigor uses his new position at the precinct to ask Roberto for Marites's freedom, but he faces a challenging condition in return. Ponggay arrives at the hotel to meet with the Mystery Man, while Tanggol prepares to take revenge on Divina.

videos.title: Reckoning
videos.overview: As part of his plan to rebuild the Montenegros from the ground up, Ramon visits a businessman who owes him both money and loyalty. While Ponggay looks for the room MysteryMan13 booked, Tanggol lurks inside Hotel Mondragon as he stalks Divina.

videos.title: Face of Corruption
videos.overview: After Roberto orchestrated a massive fire in one of Manila's barangays, Miguelito moves to access the city's calamity fund. As Rocky Boy plays with his new victim, Divina breaks out in a cold sweat when she spots Tanggol.

videos.title: Ride
videos.overview: While Roberto, Miguelito and Jackie are busy stealing from the city's calamity fund, Don Gustavo decides to visit Tindeng. Tanggol answers a call for help as he continues his pursuit of Divina.

videos.title: The Angel in the Shipyard
videos.overview: With General Rivas’s help, Ramon obtains crucial information about Don Julio and Marites’ whereabouts. As his friends try to earn some quick cash in Quiapo, Tanggol brings Ponggay to their hideout.

videos.title: Jacket
videos.overview: Rigor tries to mend his relationship with Marites. Rocky Boy and Divina reconcile and unite against a common enemy. Meanwhile, Tanggol reveals the deep wounds of his past to Ponggay and warns her about the Guerreros' true colors.

videos.title: Payola
videos.overview: Returning home from the shipyard, Ponggay tells Chona that Tanggol saved her life and chooses not to report his whereabouts to the police out of gratitude. Miguelito is furious when Divina shows up at the Guerreros’ mansion.

videos.title: Reincarceration
videos.overview: Tanggol’s friends insist on joining him and Ramon in their mission to rescue Don Julio and Marites. Santino beats up Rocky Boy for harassing Erika. Marites tells Rigor that she will no longer choose him.

videos.title: For Don Julio
videos.overview: Dimples refuses to help Ponggay track down Midnight Monster. Ramon, Tanggol, and his friends prepare to rescue Don Julio and Marites from the police. Upon arriving at his office, Rigor reflects on how his former superiors once belittled him.

videos.title: The Ambush
videos.overview: Divina loses her temper when Brando brings a woman into his home. While the police prepare to transfer Don Julio and Franco to the city jail, Tanggol’s gang sets a clever trap to ambush the convoy.

videos.title: Expired
videos.overview: The Guerreros try to placate the public with promises as they face backlash for distributing expired relief goods, prompting them to strike a deal with Divina. Tanggol's group continues to clash with the police in a bid to rescue Don Julio.

videos.title: Hesitation
videos.overview: Hector lashes out at Ponggay for compromising their mission when she hesitates to shoot Tanggol. After giving his grandson new clothes, Gustavo takes the chance to get to know Santino better. Divina begins seducing Roberto.

videos.title: Morality or Law
videos.overview: The Guerreros grow uneasy upon receiving news of Don Julio and Franco’s escape. Marites’ neighbors come to her rescue. Tanggol brims with inspiration now that his goals are aligning with those of Ramon and his grandfather.

videos.title: Ponggay's Mission
videos.overview: Roberto and Espineli strike a deal over the latter’s request for protection. Tension erupts into a brawl when Miguelito notices Santino wearing one of his old shirts. Ponggay sneaks into the shipyard with the intent of arresting the Montenegros.

videos.title: Second Thoughts
videos.overview: Roberto taps Lucio and his group to be the protectors of his new business partner. Amid the standoff between the Montenegros and Ponggay, Tanggol tries to explain their side to the policewoman. Rigor fumes upon arriving at an empty house.

videos.title: The Agreement
videos.overview: Espineli informs the Red Phoenix about his upcoming transaction, wanting to test them before hiring them as his armed men. After scaring off Taruc and his group, Ponggay decides to reach an agreement with Tanggol.

videos.title: Ramon’s Nightmare
videos.overview: Divina brims with joy when Rocky Boy expresses interest in her business. A haunting nightmare pushes Ramon to plan Marites’ rescue. Cracks begin to show in the Guerreros’ foundation as Gustavo and Erika refuse to attend Miguelito’s PR event.

videos.title: Undercover Cop
videos.overview: Divina delivers the substandard ambulances for Miguelito’s PR event at the city hall. Tanggol, his friends, and Ramon head to San Dimas to rescue Marites, unaware of the trap Rigor has set for them.

videos.title: Rigor’s Trap
videos.overview: As his family faces a financial crisis, Mauro tries to seek assistance from the Guerreros. The suspicions of Tindeng's group deepen. Tanggol and Ramon reunite with Marites, until Rigor's forces strike with a devastating surprise attack.

videos.title: Hunted
videos.overview: Tindeng receives an unwanted visitor at work. Desperate for money, Mauro turns to Roberto to settle an old score. Meanwhile, Tanggol and Ramon plunge into a chaotic gun battle with the police in a desperate bid to save Marites.

videos.title: Rescued
videos.overview: Tanggol and Ramon successfully rescue Marites, causing Rigor to lash out at his subordinates. Ponggay finds herself in a difficult position as Chona persuades her to snitch on Tanggol.

videos.title: Bribe
videos.overview: Ponggay accepts Miguelito’s offer to work as his security detail, much to Hector’s disbelief. Alberto persuades Rigor to release the two Chinese nationals in his custody. Ramon opens up to Marites about his change of heart.

videos.title: The Inept Chief
videos.overview: Tanggol grows uneasy when Marites reveals that Santino is staying with the Guerreros. After confirming that Rigor is working for Roberto, Ponggay heads to the shipyard to speak with Tanggol.

videos.title: Beaten Up
videos.overview: Hector questions Rigor’s decision to reassign Ponggay and Chona. Miguelito beats up Rocky Boy for harassing his date. Tanggol and his friends witness a disturbing scene while returning to the shipyard after accompanying Ponggay home.

videos.title: Man in the Trash
videos.overview: Mauro lands in a dangerous situation while working for Espineli during a drug transaction. Tanggol and his friends decide to rescue the unconscious man they spotted on their way back to their hideout.

videos.title: Trust and Doubt
videos.overview: Tanggol’s friends warn him against trusting Ponggay. Mauro gains the respect of Enrique and Lucio’s group after saving them during a buy-bust operation. Meanwhile, Mando tries to remind Rigor of his principles.

videos.title: Awakened Stranger
videos.overview: Tindeng is alarmed to learn that five people have died in the food poisoning outbreak caused by the Guerreros’ low-grade relief packs. Tanggol and his friends return to Mang Donato’s place to check on the man they rescued.

videos.title: Wolf in Sheep’s Clothing
videos.overview: Ponggay and Chona overhear Miguelito expressing disdain over having to mingle with the food poisoning victims. Recognizing the man who saved him, Rocky Boy spins a convincing story as he schemes to get back at Tanggol.

videos.title: No Brakes
videos.overview: The city hall erupts in chaos as Tindeng and the food poisoning victims call out Miguelito for distributing expired relief goods. Tanggol rushes to the rescue when an ambulance suddenly loses its brakes.

videos.title: Accusation
videos.overview: A heated confrontation ensues between Tindeng, the Dimaculangans, and the Guerreros when they cross paths at the city hall. Brando prepares to exact revenge on Miguelito for beating up his son, but Rock Boy claims he has a better plan in mind.

videos.title: Marcing and Nita
videos.overview: Jackie pins the food-poisoning incident on Nita and Marcing, turning the public’s wrath on them. Tanggol and his friends rush to rescue the elderly couple, unaware that someone is watching them.

videos.title: Alfredo
videos.overview: Tindeng races to secure evidence exposing the anomalies at city hall after receiving reports of stalling ambulances across the city. Her investigation, however, takes a tragic turn when Alfredo rescues her from danger while looking for documents.

videos.title: Mauro’s Ace
videos.overview: The Guerreros break into a cold sweat as Marsing and Nita’s interview airs, exposing their election fraud and distribution of expired goods. Mauro secures incriminating evidence against Roberto, unaware that he is being watched.

videos.title: Mauro
videos.overview: The Red Phoenix riddles the Garcias’ house with bullets after confirming Mauro’s plan to betray them. Tanggol, his friends, and Ponggay spring into action, trading gunfire with members of the Tondo Gang.

videos.title: Grief and Revenge
videos.overview: Ponggay and her remaining family mourn the tragic loss of their loved ones, while the policewoman vows that justice will be served. Tanggol's group drags Lucio to their hideout after deciding to keep him alive as a weapon against the Guerreros.

videos.title: Lucio’s Confession
videos.overview: Grieving and burning with rage, Ponggay seeks refuge in the Montenegros. While the Guerreros scramble to protect their legacy, Lucio makes a damaging confession against them.

videos.title: Following and Assault
videos.overview: Tindeng heads to the shipyard to see Tanggol, unaware that Rigor is watching her every move. Roberto orders Divina to fix the problem surrounding the substandard ambulances she supplied to the city.

videos.title: Explosion
videos.overview: Divina ends up seducing Roberto as she tries to resolve the controversy surrounding her ambulances, only to be caught in the act by Jackie. Tanggol and his group stand their ground as authorities close in.

videos.title: Don Julio
videos.overview: Ponggay and Chona continue to investigate Lucio's revelations about the Guerreros, while Hector brews a sinister plot. The Montenegros and Tanggol's friends fight for their lives against Rigor, only to be met with a heartbreaking loss.

videos.title: Danger
videos.overview: Worried for his family’s safety, Tanggol sends Tindeng, Marites, and Roda to a safer place. Rocky Boy reveals to Divina the identity of his ace against the Guerreros. Erika gives Santino a new look.

videos.title: Danger
videos.overview: Tindeng, Marites, and Roda go into hiding and seek refuge with Congressman Leo. Lucio reaches out to Roberto for help. Rocky Boy concocts a narrative to gain Tanggol's trust and gives him a new place to stay.

videos.title: Expose
videos.overview: Masking his murderous intent with a show of generosity, Rocky Boy welcomes Tanggol’s group into their new safehouse. Brando’s exposé against the Guerreros goes viral.

videos.title: Waiting
videos.overview: Ponggay devises a way to put Lucio’s confession to good use. As Tanggol’s group bides their time outside the Guerreros’ mansion, Don Gustavo confronts his family amid the fallout from Brando’s exposé.

videos.title: Gustavo
videos.overview: Determined to salvage the situation, Roberto arrives at the unveiling ceremony of his father’s statue. As widespread protests erupt across Manila, Tanggol’s group opens fire after catching up with the Guerreros’ convoy.

videos.title: Sibling’s Anger
videos.overview: During the inauguration ceremony honoring the Guerreros’ legacy, chaos erupts when a protester stabs Roberto. As the Guerreros flee from Tanggol and the rallyists, Erika and Santino are separated from the group, leading one of them to a tragic end.

videos.title: Guerreros' Anguish
videos.overview: Seething with rage, Santino shoots at Tanggol, holding him responsible for the tragic fate of Erika and their unborn child. The Guerreros mourn the deaths of their loved ones and vow to settle scores with the Montenegros.

videos.title: One by One
videos.overview: Arriving at Don Gustavo and Erika’s wake, Rigor witnesses Miguelito driving Santino out of the Guerreros’ mansion. Ponggay seizes an opportunity to talk to Abet. Rocky Boy is consumed by dark thoughts as Tanggol’s group recovers from their battles.

videos.title: Night of Danger
videos.overview: Ponggay secures more evidence against the Guerreros after saving an inmate from an assassination attempt. Blaming his brother for Erika’s death, Santino vows to make Tanggol pay.

videos.title: Hesus Against Death
videos.overview: Ponggay and Abet agree to seek Congressman Leo’s help in exposing the Guerreros. Miguelito plots revenge against the Mondragons without Roberto’s knowledge. Rocky Boy tricks Tanggol's friends to have his way with his target.

videos.title: Suspicion
videos.overview: Brando and Divina brace for the worst, convinced that the Guerreros will make them pay for their betrayal. Growing suspicious of Bernard after what happened to his son, Ramon urges Tanggol’s friends to leave as soon as possible.

videos.title: Divina’s House
videos.overview: Congressman Mojica rallies the opposition to oust the Guerreros from power. Hector goes over Rigor's head and sends his men to hunt down Tanggol. The Mondragons scramble to flee as the Guerreros go after them, unaware of another group pursuing them.

videos.title: Montenegro Mondragon Guerrero
videos.overview: Following Roberto’s orders, Rigor moves to disperse the rally protesting the Guerreros. As his son recovers, Ramon leads Tanggol’s friends in striking back at their enemies. Driven by vengeance, Rocky Boy arrives in San Dimas.

videos.title: The Mondragons
videos.overview: Ponggay fails to hide her disappointment upon learning that Hector is working for Miguelito. The Guerreros are stunned by the contents of Don Gustavo’s will. Ramon and Tanggol join the fray as the Mondragons are attacked.

videos.title: Divina’s Son
videos.overview: Tanggol suspects that the man who attacked him in his sleep is none other than Divina’s son. After failing to gain Myrna’s trust, Rocky Boy grows excited when he spots Ponggay in San Dimas.

videos.title: Midnight Monster
videos.overview: News of the Guerreros’ possible involvement in the Mondragons’ massacre hits the headlines. Leaving Ponggay at the mercy of his torture devices, Rocky Boy descends into madness upon learning that Tanggol killed Divina.

videos.title: Rockyboy
videos.overview: Tanggol engages in a fierce battle against Rocky Boy in a bid to save Ponggay. Meanwhile, the Guerreros lose the support of their allies one by one amid the controversies surrounding their family.

videos.title: Cornered
videos.overview: Reuniting with his family, Tanggol asks Marites to help Santino understand that he is not responsible for Erika’s death. However, he is forced to flee when Ponggay arrives bearing dire news.

videos.title: Victorino
videos.overview: Aiming to apprehend the fugitives, the police corner Tanggol’s group, opening fire in a busy street. Amid the chaos, Hector comes face to face with his target.

videos.title: Former Ally
videos.overview: Despite being arrested for helping Tanggol escape, Ponggay remains adamant about making the Guerreros pay for their crimes. Left with no other choice, Tanggol seeks help from a former ally.

videos.title: The Fall of the Guerreros
videos.overview: Tanggol's group sets out to find a chance to ambush Miguelito, unaware of another betrayal looming ahead. The Guerreros wait for their allies to rally behind them, only to see them speak out in a massive protest calling for their ouster.

videos.title: A Mother’s Plea
videos.overview: Marites returns to San Dimas to talk to Santino in hopes of ending the feud between him and Tanggol. As the enraged rallyists swarm Miguelito's car, Tanggol's group finds an opportunity to get close to the fraudulent mayor.

videos.title: Violence and Bribery
videos.overview: Rigor orders his men to use violence to suppress the growing protest against the Guerreros. As rallyists storm the election commission, Tanggol and his group seize a chance to get close to Miguelito.

videos.title: Forgiveness or a Trap
videos.overview: While Tanggol’s group works to ensure Commissioner Medina’s safety, Roberto lashes out at Jackie after learning that Miguelito acted without his consent. Santino later contacts Marites, saying he wants to meet his brother.

videos.title: The Siblings
videos.overview: News of Commissioner Medina’s interview about the recent attack at the election commission makes headlines. Tanggol arrives at the agreed rendezvous with Santino, unaware that he is walking straight into Rigor’s trap.

videos.title: Sibling Love
videos.overview: Miguelito holds a press conference to announce the bounty placed on the heads of Tanggol, Ramon, and their allies. Tanggol’s words fall on deaf ears as rage consumes Santino during their meeting.

videos.title: Santino
videos.overview: Peril closes in on Ponggay inside the prison. Tanggol's reunion with Santino ends in great sorrow as Rigor, who is lurking in the dark with his men, unleashes a fierce gunfight.

videos.title: Mourning
videos.overview: Ramon pulls Tanggol away from Santino’s lifeless body to keep him from being apprehended by the police. Marites receives tragic news about her son’s fate during a police operation led by Rigor.

videos.title: The Fight Continues
videos.overview: With both of his sons gone, Rigor vows to make it his life’s mission to give Tanggol the most painful death. As a massive group of rallyists converges on the Guerreros’ mansion, Tanggol burns with rage and swears to avenge Santino.

videos.title: The Judas of Quiapo
videos.overview: While Rigor checks on his undercover agents around San Dimas, Marites breaks down in tears upon arriving at Santino’s funeral. Plotting to betray Tanggol, Ben finds a way into city hall to get Miguelito’s attention.

videos.title: Wrongly Trusted
videos.overview: After being released from prison, Evelyn warns Tindeng and their allies that Ponggay’s life is in danger. Gina secretly tries to stop Tanggol’s group from leaving as Ben leads Miguelito to his house.

videos.title: Ben
videos.overview: Rigor erupts with fury upon learning that Marites came to Santino's wake. Ben's plan backfires as Miguelito opens fire on Tanggol's group and drags innocent lives into the chaos.

videos.title: The Father’s Sin
videos.overview: Turning his back on Rigor, Mando decides to tell Marites and Tindeng the truth behind Santino’s death. After finding a new hideout, Ramon warns Tanggol not to trust too easily in the wake of Ben’s betrayal.

videos.title: Be Careful
videos.overview: As the Guerreros’ lawyer braces for the ruling on the election recount, Alberto orders city hall barricaded against the angry rallyists. Rigor calls for reinforcements, anticipating that Tanggol will show up at Santino’s wake.

videos.title: Attack at the Wake
videos.overview: While the Guerreros’ loyalists scramble to assist them, Miguelito is left speechless when Roberto reveals that Ponggay is working with Tanggol. As Tanggol grieves Santino’s untimely death, the police arrive at the wake under Rigor’s orders.

videos.title: Disruption at the Wake
videos.overview: Rigor resolves to find another way to smoke out Tanggol after failing to apprehend him at Santino’s wake. Marites tells Tindeng that she is no longer afraid of her husband following the death of their remaining son.

videos.title: Rigor’s Revenge
videos.overview: Ponggay faces another attempt on her life while in the hospital. Consumed by grief and revenge, Rigor uses the people around Tanggol to draw him out of hiding and into his grasp.

videos.title: A Friend’s Lie
videos.overview: Returning to Tanggol’s hideout, Enteng hides his guilt as he carries out Rigor’s orders to save Myrna. Ponggay reveals to Chona and Abet that the woman who tried to assassinate her in jail is also linked to General Berbano.

videos.title: Robbery in Binondo
videos.overview: Standing before Santino’s resting place, Rigor vows to make Tanggol pay, still blaming the fugitive for the death of his remaining son. Tanggol’s group robs a jewelry repair shop to help Enteng.

videos.title: The NEC’s Decision
videos.overview: After announcing the NEC’s ruling at a press conference, Commissioner Medina heads to the city hall to personally ask the Guerreros to step down from office. Tanggol’s group tries to shake off the police tail following the heist.

videos.title: Happiness
videos.overview: Tindeng, Marites, and their allies devise a way to call out the Guerreros for refusing to honor the NEC’s ruling. After safely returning to their hideout, Enteng is weighed down by guilt as Tanggol expresses gratitude for his loyal friends.

videos.title: Rigor’s Trap
videos.overview: Adamant to stay in power, Roberto takes drastic steps to quell the protests that threaten his family. Meanwhile, Rigor orchestrates a sneak attack on Tanggol and his allies.

videos.title: The Betrayal
videos.overview: While Marites grows anxious over her mother’s arrest, Tindeng reunites with Ponggay in prison. Unaware of Rigor’s trap, Tanggol and Ramon choose to stay behind as their group attempts to fence the stolen jewelry in their possession.

videos.title: Judas
videos.overview: An argument erupts among the city councilors after the Guerreros’ former allies propose fleeing the city for their families’ safety. Enteng watches helplessly as Rigor tortures his friends to uncover Tanggol’s whereabouts.

videos.title: The Crew
videos.overview: As public outrage mounts against the Guerreros, Roberto informs Miguelito and Jackie that Rigor is now hunting down Tanggol. Enteng begs his friends for forgiveness and understanding as he carries out the ultimate betrayal.

videos.title: The Betrayal
videos.overview: As Jackie urges Roberto to use Ponggay to spin the narrative in their favor, civilians stage a peaceful protest outside city hall. Tanggol breaks down upon discovering the lifeless bodies of his friends.

videos.title: Where is Tanggol?
videos.overview: After fleeing their hideout and seeking refuge at a church, Tanggol finds renewed courage as Fr. Ruben urges him to become a beacon of hope for the people. Rigor informs Roberto that Tindeng is in his custody.

videos.title: Nazarene
videos.overview: As he prays for guidance amid the chaos, Tanggol hears a voice from above assuring him that he is not alone in his fight against injustice and oppression. Ramon devises another sinister scheme to thwart Tanggol’s aspirations.

videos.title: Tanggol's Return
videos.overview: Tanggol decides to answer his allies’ call and reveal himself to the public as the number of protesters continues to grow. The Guerreros await Ponggay’s arrival as they hold a press conference in a bid to twist the narrative in their favor.

videos.title: The Revolution
videos.overview: Ramon urges Tanggol to heed the fire in his heart as his supporters and the public gather for a massive protest against the Guerreros. Fearing for her family’s safety, Ponggay agrees to speak before the press conference at the city hall.

videos.title: Heading to City Hall
videos.overview: All hell breaks loose at the city hall as Miguelito opens fire on Tanggol and the rallyists. While both sides lose allies one by one amid the chaos, Tanggol and Ramon face their greatest foes head-on.

videos.title: New Manila
videos.overview: Roberto and Miguelito are forced to leave Jackie behind as they flee the mob’s wrath. On his first day in office, Tanggol addresses the public and outlines the reforms he plans to implement to improve the lives of Manila’s citizens.

videos.title: New Beginning
videos.overview: After a busy day working to improve the lives of Manileños, Tanggol takes Ponggay to a food stall in Quiapo and asks her to never leave his side. Roberto retrieves wads of cash from his secret stash as part of his scheme to depose the new mayor.

videos.title: Manila Warzone
videos.overview: As part of their plan to destabilize Manila and isolate the mayor from the police, Roberto and Miguelito stage an attack on the prison to free Rigor. As chaos erupts and the city descends into a warzone, Marites is kidnapped.

videos.title: The Final Reckoning
videos.overview: Backed by the police force, Tanggol sets out to rescue Marites and finally end the Guerreros’ reign of terror. Meanwhile, Roberto brims with satisfaction as the mayor takes the bait.

videos.title: The End
videos.overview: As Rigor goes to great lengths to exact revenge, Tanggol uses all of his might to defeat him and put an end to his ruthlessness. Soon, after a grueling battle against evil, a new chapter unfolds for the residents of Quiapo.
